```text
00998: +#!/usr/bin/env python3
00999: +# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
01000: +# Copyright (C) 2026-present pixelelated (https://github.com/pixelelated)
01001: +"""Run unchanged upstream hashing tests against the image's installed proxy."""
01002: +import argparse
01003: +import hashlib
01004: +import importlib.util
01005: +import json
01006: +from pathlib import Path
01007: +import runpy
01008: +import sys
01009: +import types
01010: +import unittest
01011: +
01012: +parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
01013: +parser.add_argument('--tests', required=True, type=Path)
01014: +parser.add_argument('--legacy-chd', required=True, type=Path)
01015: +parser.add_argument('--library-sha256', required=True)
01016: +parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
01017: +args = parser.parse_args()
01018: +
01019: +import raofflineproxy
01020: +from raofflineproxy import rom_browser, rom_hashing
01021: +modules = {}
01022: +for module in (rom_browser, rom_hashing):
01023: +    path = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
01024: +    if not str(path).startswith('/usr/lib/python') or '/site-packages/raofflineproxy/' not in str(path):
01025: +        sys.exit('refusing a proxy module outside the installed image: '+str(path))
01026: +    modules[module.__name__] = {'file': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
01027: +lib = rom_hashing.load_rchash()
01028: +if lib is None:
01029: +    sys.exit('installed native library unavailable: '+str(rom_hashing._LIBRCHASH_ERROR))
01030: +mapped = {line.split()[-1] for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines()
01031: +          if 'libraproxy_rchash.so' in line}
01032: +if mapped != {'/usr/lib/libraproxy_rchash.so'}:
01033: +    sys.exit('unexpected native library mappings: '+repr(mapped))
01034: +library = Path(next(iter(mapped)))
01035: +digest = hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
01036: +if digest != args.library_sha256:
01037: +    sys.exit('installed library differs from the accepted image')

01443: +LOG="$G/log"
01444: +sleep() { :; }
01445: +ssha() {

01453: +    # systemctl are fixture-backed. CI needs no namespace privilege/package.

01455: +}

01457: +    cases = [

01460: +        ('old-boot', 'previous', '1', 'active', 'current', 'present', 1, 30),
01461: +        ('failed', 'current', '1', 'failed', 'current', 'present', 1, 1),
01462: +        ('delayed', 'current', '4', 'active', 'current', 'present', 0, 4),
01463: +        ('never-ready', 'current', 'never', 'active', 'current', 'present', 1, 30),
01464: +        ('absent', 'current', '1', 'active', 'current', 'absent', 1, 30),
01465: +        ('no-identity', 'current', '1', 'active', '', 'present', 1, 0),
01466: +    ]
01467: +    for case, boot, finish, state, expected, transport, code, polls in cases:
01468: +        p = root / case

01470: +        # A stale success must not short-circuit the current boot's unit check.
01471: +        (p / 'var/log/boot.log').write_text('Previous boot: Autostart complete...\n')

01473: +        (p / 'state').write_text('activating\n')
01474: +        (p / 'polls').write_text('0\n')
01475: +        result = subprocess.run(
01476: +            ['bash', '-c', shell, 'fixture', str(p), finish, state, expected, transport],
01477: +            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
01478: +        observed_polls = int((p / 'polls').read_text())
01479: +        assert (result.returncode, observed_polls) == (code, polls), (
01480: +            case, result.returncode, observed_polls, result.stdout, result.stderr)
01481: +        assert not result.stderr, (case, result.stderr)
01482: +        assert ('PASS storage ready' if code == 0 else 'FAIL storage readiness') in result.stdout, (case, result.stdout)
01483: +        print(f'PASS {case}: return {code}, polls {polls}', flush=True)
01484: +print('PASS 7 storage-readiness controls; actual guest query, synthetic states, no boot claim')
```

## FILE .github/workflows/fork-checks.yml
Original bytes 2321; SHA256 5243b3e087e81506bee682aff3addb93a4329d43532269534e2e1fbabfaaae6b
```text
00001: # The fork's record checks, run on every push of next and once a day: the
00002: # work-log index current, the decision register sound, no friction entry
00003: # left without an issue, the retro / weekly / monthly cadence kept, every
00004: # recent blindspot naming a guard, an audit and a futro when they are owed.
00005: # Red until each overdue ceremony has its artifact (#254, D-WORKFLOW-028).
00006: # Fork-only (`fork-*`): never part of an upstream PR.
00007: name: fork record checks
00008: 
00009: on:
00010:   push:
00011:     branches: [next]
00012:   schedule:
00013:     - cron: '17 6 * * *'
00014:   workflow_dispatch:
00015:     inputs:
00016:       ceremony_today:
00017:         description: "Run the ceremony check as of this date (yyyy-mm-dd) -- the guard's constructed positive: a far date makes an audit or a futro overdue and the run red (audit #258 PL-020)"
00018:         required: false
00019:         default: ""
00020: 
00021: permissions:
00022:   contents: read
00023:   issues: read
00024: 
00025: jobs:
00026:   record:
00027:     runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
00028:     steps:
00029:       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
00030:         with:
00031:           fetch-depth: 0
00032:       - name: identify upstream history for the fork issue-coverage check
00033:         run: git fetch --no-tags https://github.com/ROCKNIX/distribution.git next:refs/remotes/upstream/next
00034:       - name: work-log index is current
00035:         run: ./tools/work-log-index --check
00036:       - name: decision register is a lookup table
00037:         run: ./tools/register-check
00038:       - name: the instruction files are what their index says
00039:         run: ./tools/rules-check
00040:       - name: builds always enter the shared watcher and retain lifecycle evidence
00041:         run: |
00042:           python3 docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-watch-job/test-watch-job.py tools/watch-job
00043:           python3 docs/qa-logs/2026-10-04-watch-progress/test-watch-build.py
00044:       - name: VM launch failures cannot report a guest as running
00045:         run: |
00046:           ./tools/vm-pair-test
00047:           ./tools/vm-upgrade-readiness-test
00048:       - name: optional hardware readings are valid or explicitly unavailable
00049:         run: ./tools/rocknix-info-test
00050:       - name: every open acceptance checkbox is agent-verifiable (D-QA-044)
00051:         env:
00052:           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
00053:         run: ./tools/box-check --quiet
00054:       - name: ceremonies are not overdue
00055:         env:
00056:           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
00057:           CEREMONY_TODAY: ${{ inputs.ceremony_today }}
00058:         run: ./tools/ceremony-check
```

## FILE projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/raofflineproxy/package.mk
Original bytes 8358; SHA256 e13f5bb22eae74c73ecb4141c3580f2627b9f8cfc317840656d90ed017e0f13d
```text
00001: # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
00002: # Copyright (C) 2026-present ROCKNIX (https://github.com/ROCKNIX)
00003: 
00004: PKG_NAME="raofflineproxy"
00005: # Current upstream main at2026-10-11 (#541); retain the fork's preparation,
00006: # recovery and explicit-consent behavior. The16 patches apply at fuzz0 after
00007: # rebasing context against the new folder watcher and paced background queue.
00008: # The OS's deliberate whole-library helper retains its own existing cooldown
00009: # after upstream removed that utility; it never labels queued work ready.
00010: # Coupled rcheevos/libchdr pins are unchanged in this parent (D-RA-029/037).
00011: # Source tests and installed-image proof remain separately recorded.
00012: PKG_VERSION="c7ebd1b6e777f3751ff0ecdf8aba54045844e00d"
00013: PKG_SHA256="88eef31acfa4104b20258bd5cea514ade30e6cdf35767ffc958009851d61898b"
00014: # GPLv3 text with no "or any later version" grant in the sources.
00015: PKG_LICENSE="GPL-3.0-only"
00016: PKG_SITE="https://github.com/misantronic/RAOfflineProxy"
00017: PKG_URL="${PKG_SITE}/archive/${PKG_VERSION}.tar.gz"
00018: # Python3 is the interpreter, and its host build carries the compileall that
00019: # python_compile runs; the service itself is stdlib-only (argparse, sqlite3,
00020: # ssl, hmac, http, socketserver, ...), all of it in the image's lib-dynload.
00021: # raofflineproxy-rcheevos and raofflineproxy-libchdr are the two submodules
00022: # the proxy's tarball leaves empty, pinned to the commits it names; make_target
00023: # below compiles them with the glue into libraproxy_rchash.so (fork #179).
00024: # And the packages whose tools the shipped scripts call (packaging-and-patches:
00025: # a shipped script's tools are dependencies too; #308 F-RA-23, F-RA-24): bash,
00026: # raofflineproxy-ctl's interpreter; busybox for flock, mkfifo, mktemp, stat,
00027: # logger, sed, awk, head, tail, date and sleep; coreutils for timeout (the
00028: # image's is coreutils', not a busybox link); grep, GNU's (the image's busybox
00029: # has no grep applet); systemd for systemctl.
00030: PKG_DEPENDS_TARGET="toolchain Python3 bash busybox coreutils grep systemd raofflineproxy-rcheevos raofflineproxy-libchdr"
00031: PKG_LONGDESC="RAOfflineProxy: a loopback proxy between the emulators and retroachievements.org that caches game data and queues casual awards earned without a connection, and sends them when one returns. Approved by RetroAchievements.org; casual (softcore) achievements only."
00032: PKG_TOOLCHAIN="manual"
00033: PKG_BUILD_FLAGS="+pic"
00034: 
00035: # OFFLINE RETROACHIEVEMENTS (fork #163/#165, D-RA-001, D-RA-002).
00036: #
00037: # What ships is the service and nothing around it: linux/raofflineproxy as a
00038: # Python module in the image's site-packages, byte-compiled like the stdlib
00039: # (the image carries .pyc only and the root filesystem is read-only, so
00040: # uncompiled sources would recompile at every start), a systemd unit gated on
00041: # the same kind of marker avahi and sshd use, and raofflineproxy-ctl, the
00042: # fork's launcher that EmulationStation's toggle drives. Not shipped: the
00043: # self-extracting bundle, the pygame menu and its SDL driver matrix, the
00044: # Tools entry, the boot hook, and the upstream config patchers -- on ROCKNIX
00045: # setsettings.sh rebuilds RetroArch's cheevos keys from system.cfg at every
00046: # launch, so the OS owns the launch-time config and points the emulators at
00047: # the proxy itself (setsettings.sh set_cheevos, cheevos_ppsspp.sh).
00048: #
00049: # SCAN GAMES FOR OFFLINE ACHIEVEMENTS (fork #179, D-RA-010) adds the one
00050: # native piece the client needs and the tarball does not carry built (and,
00051: # since fork #184 / D-RA-013, raofflineproxy-cache-indexed, which caches a
00052: # game the interface's own index identified without hashing it again):
00053: # libraproxy_rchash.so, rcheevos' rc_hash with the libchdr CHD reader and the
00054: # LZMA SDK 7z reader behind one C entry point (third_party/rcheevos_glue),
00055: # which rom_hashing.py loads through ctypes to identify a ROM the way
00056: # RetroArch does. Without it every ROM the scan looks at fails to hash. The
00057: # recipe is upstream's linux/build_rchash.sh -- the same defines, the same
00058: # source list -- run with the target compiler instead of zig, and the two
00059: # submodule trees come from the raofflineproxy-rcheevos and
00060: # raofflineproxy-libchdr packages. Checked against the QA ROMs before it
00061: # went in: the library hashes the NES fixture to a49d6f153d642026643a162b6df7af99,
00062: # the hash RetroArch itself logged for it (#179 evidence, 2026-09-14).
00063: 
00064: make_target() {
00065:   local RC="$(get_build_dir raofflineproxy-rcheevos)"
00066:   local CHDR="$(get_build_dir raofflineproxy-libchdr)"
00067:   local GLUE="${PKG_BUILD}/third_party/rcheevos_glue"
00068:   local LZMA_SDK="${PKG_BUILD}/third_party/lzma-sdk"
00069:   mkdir -p "${PKG_BUILD}/.${TARGET_NAME}"
00070:   ${CC} ${CFLAGS} ${LDFLAGS} -shared -Os -fPIC \
00071:     -DRC_HASH_NO_ENCRYPTED \
00072:     -DZ7_PPMD_SUPPORT \
00073:     -DWANT_RAW_DATA_SECTOR=1 \
00074:     -DWANT_SUBCODE=1 \
00075:     -DVERIFY_BLOCK_CRC=1 \
00076:     -I"${RC}/include" -I"${RC}/src" -I"${RC}/src/rhash" \
00077:     -I"${GLUE}" -I"${GLUE}/shim" \
00078:     -I"${CHDR}/include" -I"${CHDR}/src" \
00079:     -I"${CHDR}/deps/miniz-3.1.2" -I"${CHDR}/deps/lzma-26.02/include" -I"${CHDR}/deps/zstd-1.5.7" \
00080:     -I"${LZMA_SDK}" \
00081:     -o "${PKG_BUILD}/.${TARGET_NAME}/libraproxy_rchash.so" \
00082:     "${RC}/src/rhash/hash.c" \
00083:     "${RC}/src/rhash/hash_rom.c" \
00084:     "${RC}/src/rhash/hash_disc.c" \
00085:     "${RC}/src/rhash/hash_zip.c" \
00086:     "${RC}/src/rhash/cdreader.c" \
00087:     "${RC}/src/rhash/md5.c" \
00088:     "${RC}/src/rc_compat.c" \
00089:     "${GLUE}/chd_stream.c" \
00090:     "${GLUE}/cdfs_chd.c" \
00091:     "${GLUE}/cdfs_pbp.c" \
00092:     "${GLUE}/strl_compat.c" \
00093:     "${GLUE}/sevenzip.c" \
00094:     "${GLUE}/rchash_glue.c" \
00095:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_bitstream.c" \
00096:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_cdrom.c" \
00097:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_chd.c" \
00098:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_avhuff.c" \
00099:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_cdfl.c" \
00100:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_cdlz.c" \
00101:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_cdzl.c" \
00102:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_cdzs.c" \
00103:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_flac.c" \
00104:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_huff.c" \
00105:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_lzma.c" \
00106:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_zlib.c" \
00107:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_codec_zstd.c" \
00108:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_flac.c" \
00109:     "${CHDR}/src/libchdr_huffman.c" \
00110:     "${CHDR}/deps/miniz-3.1.2/miniz.c" \
00111:     "${CHDR}/deps/lzma-26.02/src/LzmaDec.c" \
00112:     "${CHDR}/deps/zstd-1.5.7/zstddeclib.c" \
00113:     "${LZMA_SDK}"/*.c
00114: }
00115: 
00116: makeinstall_target() {
00117:   local SITE="${INSTALL}/usr/lib/${PKG_PYTHON_VERSION}/site-packages"
00118:   mkdir -p "${SITE}"
00119:   cp -r "${PKG_BUILD}/linux/raofflineproxy" "${SITE}/raofflineproxy"
00120:   rm -rf "${SITE}/raofflineproxy/__pycache__"
00121:   # The SDL menu's fonts and donation QR images. menu_sdl.py only names the
00122:   # paths at import; nothing on this image draws that menu.
00123:   rm -rf "${SITE}/raofflineproxy/assets"
00124:   rm -f "${SITE}"/raofflineproxy/font-mono*.ttf
00125:   python_compile "${SITE}/raofflineproxy"
00126: 
00127:   mkdir -p "${INSTALL}/usr/bin"
00128:   cp "${PKG_DIR}/sources/raofflineproxy-ctl" "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-ctl"
00129:   chmod 0755 "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-ctl"
00130:   # The scan's worker (fork #184, D-RA-013): caches a game the interface's
00131:   # index already identified from its id and hash, and hands the rest to the
00132:   # client's own hashing path. The ctl looks for it beside itself.
00133:   cp "${PKG_DIR}/sources/raofflineproxy-cache-indexed" "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-cache-indexed"
00134:   chmod 0755 "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-cache-indexed"
00135: 
00136:   # The images of what is cached, fetched until none is missing (#212): the
00137:   # same action as caching the achievements, run at the end of a scan and a
00138:   # top-up and available on its own as `raofflineproxy-ctl images`.
00139:   cp "${PKG_DIR}/sources/raofflineproxy-cache-images" "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-cache-images"
00140:   chmod 0755 "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-cache-images"
00141:   cp "${PKG_DIR}/sources/raofflineproxy-refresh" "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-refresh"
00142:   chmod 0755 "${INSTALL}/usr/bin/raofflineproxy-refresh"
00143: 
00144:   # /usr/lib is the first system path rom_hashing.py's loader tries after the
00145:   # module's own directory.
00146:   mkdir -p "${INSTALL}/usr/lib"
00147:   cp "${PKG_BUILD}/.${TARGET_NAME}/libraproxy_rchash.so" "${INSTALL}/usr/lib/libraproxy_rchash.so"
00148:   chmod 0644 "${INSTALL}/usr/lib/libraproxy_rchash.so"
00149: }
00150: 
00151: post_install() {
00152:   # Enabled in the image; the unit's ConditionPathExists on
00153:   # /storage/.cache/services/raofflineproxy.conf is the off-switch, and
00154:   # raofflineproxy-ctl (and, at boot, /usr/lib/autostart/daemons) owns that
00155:   # marker.
00156:   enable_service raofflineproxy.service
00157: }
```

## FILE projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/raofflineproxy/patches/001-dorequest-4xx-passthrough.patch
Original bytes 3097; SHA256 e322a8dd83354185fb3a774fe5d1adabebfcd199a06e18c40c255dffe9197239
```text
00001: proxy_service: pass a 4xx from dorequest.php through instead of answering 503
00002: 
00003: RetroAchievements answers a dorequest.php call it understood but cannot
00004: satisfy with a 4xx whose body names the reason -- 404 with
00005: {"Success":false,"Error":"Unknown game",...} for a hash that has no
00006: achievement set, 400 for a malformed parameter. handle_online_request turned
00007: every non-2xx into 503 {"Success":false,"Error":"upstream unavailable"}, so
00008: an emulator behind the proxy reports "Load failed (-27): upstream
00009: unavailable" for a ROM the server had in fact answered about, where the same
00010: launch without the proxy reads "Load failed (-29): Unknown game". The player
00011: is sent looking for a connection problem that does not exist, and the
00012: message is false: upstream answered.
00013: 
00014: Pass a 4xx from dorequest.php through as it came, status and body, except
00015: 401 and 403. An auth failure keeps today's 503, so this change touches
00016: nothing about how the proxy handles credentials (the login actions' cached
00017: responses, the token the flusher carries). 5xx and network errors keep the
00018: 503 and the offline path as before; forward_to_upstream and the login and
00019: award paths already passed an http_error through unchanged, so this brings
00020: the general online path in line with them.
00021: 
00022: Seen on ROCKNIX (fork issue maxengel/rocknix#166) with the proxy at
00023: 64d03d30633ca6e7719c26d732cef3c97dedcc27: RetroArch through the proxy logged
00024: "Load failed (-27): upstream unavailable" for a fixture ROM RA answered 404
00025: for, and "Load failed (-29): Unknown game" without it. Offered upstream
00026: as-is (ROCKNIX D-RA-002: whatever the fork changes in the proxy goes back).
00027: 
00028: diff --git a/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py b/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py
00029: --- a/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py
00030: +++ b/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py
00031: @@ -84,6 +84,20 @@
00032:  CACHE_QUEUE_POLL_SECONDS = 60
00033:  WORKER_STOP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.0
00034:  ALWAYS_TRY_UPSTREAM_ACTIONS = {"login", "login2"}
00035: +# A 4xx RetroAchievements sends for a dorequest.php call it understood but
00036: +# cannot satisfy -- 404 "Unknown game" for a hash with no set, 400 for a bad
00037: +# parameter -- carries the reason the emulator shows the player, and passes
00038: +# through as it came. 401 and 403 do not: an auth failure keeps the 503, so
00039: +# nothing about how credentials are handled changes here.
00040: +AUTH_FAILURE_STATUSES = {401, 403}
00041: +
00042: +
00043: +def is_passthrough_client_error(path: str, status: int) -> bool:
00044: +    return (
00045: +        path.startswith("/dorequest.php")
00046: +        and 400 <= status < 500
00047: +        and status not in AUTH_FAILURE_STATUSES
00048: +    )
00049:  
00050:  
00051:  def is_static_asset_request(path: str) -> bool:
00052: @@ -528,6 +542,12 @@
00053:              return self.handle_offline_request(path, raw_body, action)
00054:  
00055:          if upstream[0] != "success":
00056: +            if upstream[0] == "http_error" and is_passthrough_client_error(
00057: +                path, upstream[1]
00058: +            ):
00059: +                return raw_response_bytes(
00060: +                    upstream[1], upstream[3], upstream[4], upstream[2]
00061: +                )
00062:              return error_json(503, "upstream unavailable")
00063:  
00064:          status_code = upstream[1]
```

```text
00003: PeriodicRefresh has no exception boundary: refresh_game_patch raises

00017: bounds it by what the player plays rather than by the size of the library,
```

## FILE projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/raofflineproxy/patches/011-offline-login-header.patch
Original bytes 5151; SHA256 09670dcaa8f7b74ffd0b0e01a4103880157955ed8e902b0918d65c02e2977154
```text
00001: proxy_service: say in the headers where an answer came from
00002: 
00003: An emulator behind this process cannot tell an answer from the store from
00004: one that came from RetroAchievements: both arrive as 200 OK with the same
00005: body, by design. So when the store answers a login because the link is
00006: down, RetroArch's own toast reads "RetroAchievements: Logged in as
00007: "<name>"." -- true, and misleading to a player who knows the Wi-Fi is off
00008: and expects to be told something has changed (ROCKNIX fork #194, the RG SP,
00009: 2026-09-15). The login body cannot carry the fact: rcheevos takes the
00010: account name straight from it and reads no other field the proxy could
00011: mark.
00012: 
00013: Two response headers say it instead. `X-RA-Proxy: 1` is on every response
00014: this process writes, online or offline -- a client can tell the proxy is
00015: in the path. `X-RA-Offline: 1` is on the answer handle_offline_login gives,
00016: a login served from the store because upstream could not be reached.
00017: Nothing else changes: the status lines, the bodies and Content-Length are
00018: as before, the login path is otherwise untouched, and a client that does
00019: not look at the headers sees what it saw. RetroArch on ROCKNIX reads the
00020: second header and says "(offline)" in its toast (patch
00021: 0013-cheevos-offline-proxy-toast in the fork's retroarch package).
00022: 
00023: Written for ROCKNIX (fork issue maxengel/rocknix#194). Offered upstream
00024: as-is (ROCKNIX D-RA-002, D-RA-016: whatever the fork changes in the proxy
00025: goes back); the headers are additive and cost a client nothing.
00026: 
00027: diff --git a/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py b/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py
00028: --- a/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py
00029: +++ b/linux/raofflineproxy/proxy_service.py
00030: @@ -93,6 +93,14 @@
00031:  # through as it came. 401 and 403 do not: an auth failure keeps the 503, so
00032:  # nothing about how credentials are handled changes here.
00033:  AUTH_FAILURE_STATUSES = {401, 403}
00034: +# ROCKNIX (fork #194): two response headers say where an answer came from,
00035: +# for an emulator that wants to tell the player. X-RA-Proxy: 1 is on every
00036: +# response this process writes; X-RA-Offline: 1 is on a login the store
00037: +# answered because upstream could not be reached. RetroArch's sign-in toast
00038: +# can then read "(offline)" -- rcheevos takes the account name straight from
00039: +# the login body, so there is no field in it the proxy could say this in.
00040: +PROXY_HEADER = ("X-RA-Proxy", "1")
00041: +OFFLINE_LOGIN_HEADER = ("X-RA-Offline", "1")
00042:  
00043:
```

## FILE projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/raofflineproxy/patches/012-offline-image-miss.patch
Original bytes 7731; SHA256 4ef3b0259af88953ea5652207f474e83b4ef551996eeffc6dd7a9d7d3d5fab33
```text
00001: proxy_service: an image the store does not hold is a 404 at once, offline or store-only
00002: 
00003: A game's icon or an achievement's badge is asked of this process on the
00004: path RetroArch uses (/Images/..., /Badge/..., /UserPic/...) and answered
00005: from the image cache when it is there. When it was not, the process asked
00006: is_online(), and if the answer was yes fetched the image from
00007: media.retroachievements.org with a ten-second timeout -- ten seconds that
00008: do not bound the name lookup -- before answering 204. is_online() is not
00009: free either: while the reachability tracker says unreachable it probes on
00010: every call (network.should_probe_retroachievements), a HEAD to
00011: retroachievements.org with a five-second timeout of the same kind, spared
00012: only when no interface but lo has operstate "up"; and the request handler
00013: had already asked it once more, for its log line. So on a link that is up
00014: and leads nowhere -- a hotspot with no data, a router whose uplink is down,
00015: the fifteen seconds after any drop before the monitor's next probe -- an
00016: image the store does not hold costs a fetch that has to fail, or two
00017: probes: tens of seconds, and ROCKNIX's summary page asks for one per
00018: visible row while it shows the device's copy (fork #199).
00019: 
00020: Now such a miss is answered 404 at once, with no probe and no upstream
00021: attempt, when the request carries X-RA-Store-Only: 1 (patch 010's header,
00022: which ROCKNIX's interface sends on every request whose host is this proxy)
00023: or when this process's own state is offline -- the tracker as the monitor
00024: last left it, the same state online_state.json carries -- and the handler's
00025: log line reads that state instead of probing for an image request. A miss
00026: while the state is online fetches and caches as before; a hit is served as
00027: before; a dorequest.php call is untouched; nothing else changes. 404 rather
00028: than the 204 a failed fetch gives: RetroArch writes a badge for a 200 only
00029: (cheevos_client.c) and logs both alike, and a client that saves the body to
00030: a file keeps a non-2xx answer out of its image cache, where a 204 lands as
00031: an empty file it then has to notice and remove (ROCKNIX #180).
00032: 
00033: No lock serialises these requests: the runtime server is a
00034: socketserver.ThreadingMixIn TCPServer, one thread per connection, and the
00035: tracker's lock is held for a read. The 137 s that opened #199 -- four
00036: /Images/ requests logged in one second, nothing for 137 s, the list "134 s
00037: after A" -- was not this process waiting: the proof's own frames show the
00038: list on screen 1.7 s after A (the frame it took for the wait card is
00039: byte-identical to the list frame it took 135 s later), so its timer was
00040: waiting for a change from a screen that had already changed, and the key
00041: press that ended the wait scrolled new rows, and new icon requests, into
00042: view. The link there was down, so the probe short-circuited on operstate
00043: and each miss was a 204 at once; the cost this patch removes is the one a
00044: link that is up and dead would have charged.
00045: 
00046: Written for ROCKNIX (fork issue maxengel/rocknix#199). Offered upstream
00047: as-is (ROCKNIX D-RA-002, D-RA-016: whatever the fork changes in the proxy
00048: goes back).
```

```text
00004: #
00005: # raofflineproxy-cache-indexed - cache games for offline achievements from a
00006: # job list raofflineproxy-ctl writes, one game per line (fork #184 note 5b,
00007: # D-RA-013):
00008: #
00009: #   I<TAB><gameId><TAB><hash><TAB><path>   a game the interface's own index
00010: #                                          already identified: cached from
00011: #                                          the id and the hash, the ROM is
00012: #                                          never read
00013: #   H<TAB><TAB><TAB><path>                 a game with no index entry: the
00014: #                                          client's own add_rom_to_cache
00015: #                                          (hash the ROM, ask RetroAchievements
00016: #                                          which game it is, cache it)
00017: #
00018: # It speaks cache-roms' lines on stdout so the ctl's reader is unchanged --
00019: # "OK <i>/<n> <file>", "FAIL <i>/<n> <file>: <reason>", "DONE cached=<c>
00020: # failed=<f> indexed=<i>" (the last field is how many of the cached came
00021: # from the index) -- and says on stderr, per game, which RetroAchievements
00022: # actions it asked, so the scan log shows an indexed game costing patch,
00023: # unlocks and achievementsets and never gameid. The client's own courtesies
00024: # stay: its throttle between requests, its cooldown per batch, its backoff
00025: # on 429 (network.py), and its redaction of the token in what it logs.
00026: #
00027: # An indexed game is cached the way add_rom_to_cache would have cached it
00028: # after the lookup: cache_game (the patch by id, the player's unlocks, the
00029: # achievement sets by hash, a session), the gameid alias for the hash (a
00030: # RetroArch that asks gameid before patch is answered offline), and the ROM's
00031: # path on the patch row (the client's browser and the ctl's own walk read it
00032: # as "already cached"). Nothing here prints a value from system.cfg; the
00033: # credentials pass through the client's resolve_credentials and no further.
00034: from __future__ import annotations
00035: 
00036: import json
00037: import os
00038: import sys
00039: import threading
00040: import time
00041: from pathlib import Path
00042: 
00043: from raofflineproxy import cache_budget, cache_keys, image_cache, network, rate_limit, rom_browser, rom_cache
00044: from raofflineproxy.auth import resolve_credentials
00045: from raofflineproxy.config import configure_logging, image_caching_enabled, load_config
00046: from raofflineproxy.rom_browser import add_rom_to_cache, normalize_cached_rom_path
00047: from raofflineproxy.rom_cache import cache_game
00048: from raofflineproxy.storage import Storage, current_millis
00049: from raofflineproxy.utils import proxy_user_agent, self_user_agent
00050: 
00051: # Every RetroAchievements action a game cost, in order. http_get is bound by
00052: # name in the two modules that call it, so both names are wrapped.
00053: ASKED: list[str] = []
00054: _real_http_get = network.http_get
00055: 
00056: 
00057: def _counting_http_get(url: str, user_agent: str) -> str:
00058:     ASKED.append(network.api_action_from_url(url) or "?")
00059:     return _real_http_get(url, user_agent)
00060: 
00061: 
00062: network.http_get = _counting_http_get
00063: rom_browser.http_get = _counting_http_get
00064: rom_cache.http_get = _counting_http_get
00065: 
00066: 
00067: def note(text: str) -> None:
00068:     print(text, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
00069: 
00070: 
00071: def apply_scan_batch_cooldown(scanned: int) -> bool:
00072:     # Upstream removed this helper when its background queue adopted pacing.
00073:     # Keep the deliberate OS preparation command's existing 50-game/30-second
00074:     # cadence; upstream request throttling and persisted 429 pauses still apply.
00075:     if scanned > 0 and scanned % 50 == 0:
00076:         note(f"Scan batch cooldown after {scanned} scanned, sleeping 30s")
00077:         time.sleep(30.0)
00078:         return True
00079:     return False
00080: 
00081: 
00082: def wait_for_badges(seconds: float) -> None:
00083:     """The badge images the games queued are still coming down in image_cache's
00084:     pool, whose workers are not daemon threads: left alone, the process would
00085:     live until the last one landed -- on the RG SP 83 s past its DONE, until
00086:     the ctl's bound killed it and read the kill as the verdict (fork #188).
00087:     Give them `seconds`, then drop what has not started (the games are cached
00088:     either way; a badge that did not come is fetched when a page asks for it
00089:     online, and offline the page shows the blank it already tolerates)."""
00090:     waiter = threading.Thread(target=lambda: image_cache._image_download_executor.shutdown(wait=True), daemon=True)
00091:     waiter.start()
00092:     waiter.join(timeout=max(0.0, seconds))
00093:     if waiter.is_alive():
00094:         note(f"badge downloads still running after {int(seconds)} s; the rest are dropped (fetched when a page asks for them online)")
00095:         image_cache.shutdown_image_downloads()
00096: 
00097: 
00098: def cache_indexed(game_id: int, hash_value: str, path: Path, credentials: dict,
00099:                   storage: Storage, config_data: dict) -> str:
00100:     """Cache one game from its id and hash. Returns the title cached."""
00101:     hash_value = cache_keys.normalize_hash(hash_value)
00102:     user_agent = proxy_user_agent(self_user_agent())
00103:     paused = max(rate_limit.paused_until() or 0, cache_budget.load(storage).paused_until)
00104:     if paused > current_millis():
00105:         raise rate_limit.RateLimitedError("RetroAchievements asked to slow down; try again later")
00106:     try:
00107:         with rate_limit.background():
00108:             cache_game(
00109:                 game_id,
00110:                 hash_value,
00111:                 credentials,
00112:                 user_agent,
00113:                 storage,
00114:                 config_data,
00115:                 cache_images=image_caching_enabled(config_data),
00116:             )
00117:     finally:
00118:         paused = rate_limit.paused_until()
00119:         if paused is not None:
00120:             cache_budget.pause_until(storage, paused)
00121:     storage.upsert_cache(
00122:         cache_keys.game_id(hash_value),
00123:         json.dumps({"GameID": game_id}, separators=(",", ":")),
00124:     )
00125:     patch_key = cache_keys.patch(game_id, credentials["user"])
00126:     patch_entry = storage.get_cache(patch_key)
00127:     if patch_entry is None:
00128:         raise rom_cache.CacheGameError("patch data was not stored")
00129:     storage.upsert_cache(
00130:         patch_key,
00131:         patch_entry["responseBody"],
00132:         source_rom_path=normalize_cached_rom_path(path),
00133:     )
00134:     try:
00135:         title = (json.loads(patch_entry["responseBody"]).get("PatchData") or {}).get("Title")
00136:     except Exception:
00137:         title = None
00138:     return title or f"Game {game_id}"
00139: 
00140: 
00141: def main() -> int:
00142:     if len(sys.argv) != 2:
00143:         print("usage: raofflineproxy-cache-indexed <jobs-file>", file=sys.stderr)
00144:         return 2
00145:     configure_logging()
00146:     config_data = load_config()
00147: 
00148:     jobs: list[tuple[str, int, str, Path]] = []
00149:     for raw in Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
00150:         if not raw.strip():
00151:             continue
00152:         fields = raw.split("\t", 3)
00153:         if len(fields) != 4 or fields[0] not in ("I", "H"):
00154:             note(f"job line not understood, skipped: {raw[:80]}")
00155:             continue
00156:         kind, game_id, hash_value, path = fields
00157:         try:
00158:             jobs.append((kind, int(game_id) if game_id else 0, hash_value.strip(), Path(path)))
00159:         except ValueError:
00160:             note(f"job line not understood, skipped: {raw[:80]}")
00161:     if not jobs:
00162:         print("DONE cached=0 failed=0 indexed=0", flush=True)
00163:         return 0
00164: 
00165:     cached = failed = indexed = 0
00166:     total = len(jobs)
00167:     storage = Storage()
00168:     try:
00169:         # Once, before the first game: the same source the client itself
00170:         # reads (a token from system.cfg, else the proxy's cached sign-in,
00171:         # else a sign-in from the password). None is the client's own
00172:         # "login required", said on every line as cache-roms says it.
00173:         credentials = resolve_credentials(storage, config_data, self_user_agent())
00174:         for index, (kind, game_id, hash_value, path) in enumerate(jobs, start=1):
00175:             apply_scan_batch_cooldown(index - 1)
00176:             label = path.name
00177:             ASKED.clear()
00178:             if credentials is None:
00179:                 failed += 1
00180:                 print(f"FAIL {index}/{total} {label}: RetroAchievements login required", flush=True)
00181:                 continue
00182:             if kind == "I" and game_id > 0 and hash_value:
00183:                 try:
00184:                     title = cache_indexed(game_id, hash_value, path, credentials, storage, config_data)
00185:                 except Exception as error:
00186:                     failed += 1
00187:                     print(f"FAIL {index}/{total} {label}: {error}", flush=True)
00188:                     note(f"indexed {index}/{total} {label}: game {game_id} could not be cached; asked {','.join(ASKED) or 'nothing'}")
00189:                     continue
00190:                 cached += 1
00191:                 indexed += 1
00192:                 print(f"OK {index}/{total} {label}", flush=True)
00193:                 note(f"indexed {index}/{total} {label}: game {game_id} '{title}' cached from the index, hash reused, not hashed; asked {','.join(ASKED) or 'nothing'}")
00194:                 continue
00195: 
00196:             if not path.is_file():
00197:                 failed += 1
00198:                 print(f"FAIL {index}/{total} {label}: not found", flush=True)
00199:                 continue
00200:             try:
00201:                 result = add_rom_to_cache(path, storage, config_data, budgeted=False)
00202:             except Exception as error:
00203:                 failed += 1
00204:                 print(f"FAIL {index}/{total} {label}: {error}", flush=True)
00205:                 continue
00206:             if result.success and not result.queued:
00207:                 cached += 1
00208:                 print(f"OK {index}/{total} {label}", flush=True)
00209:             else:
00210:                 failed += 1
00211:                 print(f"FAIL {index}/{total} {label}: {result.message}", flush=True)
00212:             note(f"hashed {index}/{total} {label}: no index entry, the ROM was hashed and looked up; asked {','.join(ASKED) or 'nothing'}")
00213:     finally:
00214:         storage.close()

00216:     print(f"DONE cached={cached} failed={failed} indexed={indexed}", flush=True)
```
