00001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
00002: # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
00003: # Copyright (C) 2026-present pixelelated (https://github.com/pixelelated)
00004: """Run unchanged upstream hashing tests against the image's installed proxy."""
00005: import argparse
00006: import hashlib
00007: import importlib.util
00008: import json
00009: from pathlib import Path
00010: import runpy
00011: import sys
00012: import types
00013: import unittest
00014: 
00015: parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
00016: parser.add_argument('--tests', required=True, type=Path)
00017: parser.add_argument('--legacy-chd', required=True, type=Path)
00018: parser.add_argument('--library-sha256', required=True)
00019: parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
00020: args = parser.parse_args()
00021: 
00022: import raofflineproxy
00023: from raofflineproxy import rom_browser, rom_hashing
00024: modules = {}
00025: for module in (rom_browser, rom_hashing):
00026:     path = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
00027:     if not str(path).startswith('/usr/lib/python') or '/site-packages/raofflineproxy/' not in str(path):
00028:         sys.exit('refusing a proxy module outside the installed image: '+str(path))
00029:     modules[module.__name__] = {'file': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
00030: lib = rom_hashing.load_rchash()
00031: if lib is None:
00032:     sys.exit('installed native library unavailable: '+str(rom_hashing._LIBRCHASH_ERROR))
00033: mapped = {line.split()[-1] for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines()
00034:           if 'libraproxy_rchash.so' in line}
00035: if mapped != {'/usr/lib/libraproxy_rchash.so'}:
00036:     sys.exit('unexpected native library mappings: '+repr(mapped))
00037: library = Path(next(iter(mapped)))
00038: digest = hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
00039: if digest != args.library_sha256:
00040:     sys.exit('installed library differs from the accepted image')
00041: 
00042: # Upstream imports linux.raofflineproxy from its repository layout. Bind that
00043: # namespace to these already-verified installed modules; do not copy product
00044: # source over the image or edit the upstream test file (#547).
00045: linux = types.ModuleType('linux')
00046: linux.__path__ = []
00047: linux.raofflineproxy = raofflineproxy
00048: sys.modules['linux'] = linux
00049: sys.modules['linux.raofflineproxy'] = raofflineproxy
00050: sys.modules['linux.raofflineproxy.rom_browser'] = rom_browser
00051: sys.modules['linux.raofflineproxy.rom_hashing'] = rom_hashing
00052: spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('installed_native_test', args.tests)
00053: module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
00054: spec.loader.exec_module(module)
00055: assert module.rom_browser is rom_browser and module.rom_hashing is rom_hashing
00056: suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module)
00057: count = suite.countTestCases()
00058: if count == 0:
00059:     sys.exit('upstream test discovery returned no cases')
00060: result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
00061: report = {'tests_discovered': count, 'tests_run': result.testsRun,
00062:           'failures': len(result.failures), 'errors': len(result.errors),
00063:           'skipped': len(result.skipped), 'modules': modules,
00064:           'library': str(library), 'library_sha256': digest,
00065:           'tests_sha256': hashlib.sha256(args.tests.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
00066: report['legacy_chd'] = runpy.run_path(str(args.legacy_chd))['exercise'](lib)
00067: args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
00068: if result.testsRun != count or not result.wasSuccessful() or result.skipped:
00069:     sys.exit('installed native tests failed or skipped; see retained report')
00070: print('PASS all %d installed native cases and legacy CHD controls; no skips' % count)

00007: # agreed, and one guest cannot make one. Conflict and bisync testing runs
00008: # here and never on a handheld (D-QA-009).
00009: #
00010: #   ./tools/vm-pair up <ROCKNIX-GENERIC_X64...img.gz>   # two 16 GiB disks, two headless guests, a QA key in each
00011: #   ./tools/vm-pair ssh a 'uname -r'                     # a command over SSH (the harness's transport)
00012: #   ./tools/vm-pair serial b 'df -h /storage'            # a command over the serial console
00013: #   ./tools/vm-pair info                                 # ports, sockets, the key
00014: #   ./tools/vm-pair down                                 # both, by pidfile
00015: #   ./tools/vm-pair reimage b <other...img.gz>           # one guest rebuilt from another image, the other left running
00016: #
00017: # Guest a keeps generic-x64-vm's defaults (SSH 10022, monitor and serial at
00018: # /tmp/rocknix-qemu-*.sock, pidfile $RUNTIME/rocknix-qemu.pid, VNC :9, the
00019: # profile's MAC 52:54:00:52:4E:58); guest b gets the same with a -b suffix,
00020: # SSH 10023, VNC :10 and its own MAC, 52:54:00:52:4E:59. Both sit behind
00021: # user-mode NAT, so a shared MAC would collide on no network -- but
00022: # cloud_device_id hashes the permanent MAC, and two guests on the profile's
00023: # address printed one id between them (fork #91): one settings folder, one
00024: # manifest, and two-device fixtures agreeing with themselves. The id is
00025: # derived on first boot and then stored on the disk, so a pair started before
00026: # guest b had its own address keeps the shared id until `up` rebuilds the
00027: # disks; clearing the stored id alone re-derives the same one. Both reach
00028: # the host's QA backend at 10.0.2.2. Disks live under $VM_PAIR_DIR
00029: # (default /tmp/rocknix-vm-pair): scratch, rebuilt from the image on every up.
00030: set -euo pipefail
00031: HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
00032: ROOT=$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)
00033: VM_TOOL="$ROOT/projects/ROCKNIX/devices/GENERIC_X64/vm/generic-x64-vm"
00034: DIR="${VM_PAIR_DIR:-/tmp/rocknix-vm-pair}"

00053: # is hardware GL through virgl on the host's first Mesa render node (#291), and
00054: # the harness takes its frames over the VNC display when the monitor has no surface.

00238:   local ha hb sa sb
00239:   ha=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10022 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 'hostname' 2>/dev/null)
00240:   hb=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10023 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 'hostname' 2>/dev/null)
00241:   sa=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10022 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 '. /etc/profile; clean_hostname "$(get_setting system.hostname)"' 2>/dev/null)
00242:   sb=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10023 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 '. /etc/profile; clean_hostname "$(get_setting system.hostname)"' 2>/dev/null)
00243:   echo "guest a: hostname=${ha:-?} setting=${sa:-?}"; echo "guest b: hostname=${hb:-?} setting=${sb:-?}"
00244:   [ -n "$ha" ] && [ -n "$hb" ] || { echo "a guest did not answer its hostname"; return 1; }
00245:   [ "$ha" != "$hb" ] || { echo "FAIL: the guests share a hostname (${ha}): the shipped family name was not made the unit's own"; bad=1; }
00246:   [ "$ha" = "$sa" ] && [ "$hb" = "$sb" ] || { echo "FAIL: a kernel hostname differs from its stored setting"; bad=1; }
00247:   # And each answers for its own name over mDNS (#50 box 6, D-NET-003; audit
00248:   # #151 PL-01): avahi logs `Host name is <x>.local` when it publishes, and
00249:   # <x> has to be the kernel name network-base-setup wrote. The daemon reads
00250:   # the kernel name when it comes up, so a unit that starts before the write
00251:   # publishes the image's name for the whole boot -- on 519f40aa0c guest b
00252:   # answered for ROCKNIX.local while named GENERIC-X64-0964, and nothing
00253:   # corrected it. The last `Host name is` line is the one in force; none at
00254:   # all is a FAIL too -- a responder that has not published, or a journal
00255:   # this could not read, is not a responder proven to answer.
00256:   local ma mb
00257:   ma=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10022 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 'journalctl -b -u avahi-daemon -o cat 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s/.*Host name is \([^ .]*\)\.local.*/\1/p" | tail -1' 2>/dev/null)
00258:   mb=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10023 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 'journalctl -b -u avahi-daemon -o cat 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s/.*Host name is \([^ .]*\)\.local.*/\1/p" | tail -1' 2>/dev/null)
00259:   local pa=${ma:+$ma.local} pb=${mb:+$mb.local}
00260:   echo "guest a: mdns=${pa:-?}"; echo "guest b: mdns=${pb:-?}"
00261:   if [ -z "$ma" ] || [ -z "$mb" ]; then
00262:     echo "FAIL: a guest's avahi journal has no 'Host name is' line: the responder has not published, or the journal could not be read"; bad=1
00263:   else
00264:     [ "$ma" = "$ha" ] || { echo "FAIL: guest a answers over mDNS for ${ma}.local while named ${ha}: the responder published before network-base-setup wrote the name"; bad=1; }
00265:     [ "$mb" = "$hb" ] || { echo "FAIL: guest b answers over mDNS for ${mb}.local while named ${hb}: the responder published before network-base-setup wrote the name"; bad=1; }
00266:   fi
00267:   [ "$bad" = 0 ] || return 1
00268:   echo "two devices, two names, each answering for its own over mDNS"
00269: }
00270: case ",$ONLY," in *,pair-identity,*) run_suite pair-identity "$OUT/pair-identity.log" pair_identity_suite ;; esac
00271: # A fresh boot lands where an update lands (upgrade-and-install.md, "The two
00272: # questions"). userconfig-setup copies /usr/config on first boot and then
00273: # links the files the OS manages; a file it did not exclude from the copy
00274: # stands where the link goes and the ln -s fails without a word, so a fresh
00275: # device carries a copy while an updated one carries a link. es_savestates.cfg
00276: # shipped that way for two weeks (audit #258 PL-001). Guest a is booted from
00277: # the image by this runner, so it is exactly the fresh device in question.
00278: fresh_suite() {
00279:   local bad=0 f target
00280:   for f in es_features.cfg es_systems.cfg es_savestates.cfg; do
00281:     target=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10022 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 "readlink /storage/.config/emulationstation/$f" 2>/dev/null)
00282:     echo "guest a: emulationstation/$f -> ${target:-(not a link)}"
00283:     [ "$target" = "/usr/config/emulationstation/$f" ] || { echo "FAIL: /storage/.config/emulationstation/$f is not a link to /usr/config/emulationstation/$f on a fresh boot -- userconfig-setup copied it and the link was not made"; bad=1; }
00284:   done
00285:   target=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10022 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 'readlink /storage/.config/SDL-GameControllerDB/gamecontrollerdb.txt' 2>/dev/null)
00286:   echo "guest a: SDL-GameControllerDB/gamecontrollerdb.txt -> ${target:-(not a link)}"
00287:   [ "$target" = "/usr/config/SDL-GameControllerDB/gamecontrollerdb.txt" ] || { echo "FAIL: the controller database is not a link on a fresh boot"; bad=1; }
00288:   local conf
00289:   conf=$(ssh -n -i "$KEY" -p 10022 $SSHO root@127.0.0.1 '[ -e /storage/.configured ] && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
00290:   echo "guest a: /storage/.configured ${conf:-?}"
00291:   [ "$conf" = yes ] || { echo "FAIL: /storage/.configured is absent: first-boot configuration did not finish, or the guest did not answer"; bad=1; }
00292:   [ "$bad" = 0 ] || return 1
00293: }
00294: case ",$ONLY," in *,fresh,*) run_suite fresh "$OUT/fresh.log" fresh_suite ;; esac
00295: case ",$ONLY," in *,round-trip,*) run_suite round-trip "$OUT/round-trip.log" "$ROOT/tools/cloud-round-trip" --host root@127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --identity "$KEY" --backend "$BACKEND" ;; esac
00296: case ",$ONLY," in *,exit,*)       run_suite exit       "$OUT/exit.log"       "$ROOT/tools/emulator-exit-test" --port "$PORT" --identity "$KEY" --vm ;; esac
00297: # The walks open pages that refuse without a remote (NO CLOUD STORAGE IS SET
00298: # UP ON THIS DEVICE YET. SET IT UP NOW?), and the round-trip suite, which runs
00299: # first, puts the guest's rclone.conf back to how it found it -- on a fresh
00300: # pair, absent. Seven walks failed at that dialog on af2db4ab09 (2026-09-11)
00301: # while the same suite had read PASS on the image before, whose fixed-wait
00302: # walks passed whenever the tool ran (#125). Seed the QA remote when there is
00303: # none, the way seed-device does, and the folders the transfer page expects.
00304: ACTIVE_READER='if test -f "$(dirname "$(command -v cloud_remote)")/cloud_connections.py"; then cloud_remote active; else rclone listremotes 2>/dev/null | head -1; fi'
00305: ensure_remote() {
00306:   [ -n "$(SSH "$ACTIVE_READER" 2>/dev/null)" ] && return 0
00307:   # A saved account or an explicit no-selection is not a fresh guest.
00308:   if SSH 'test -s /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf || test -e /storage/.config/rclone/active-connection' 2>/dev/null; then
00309:     echo "vm-qa: choose the QA connection explicitly; saved connection state is present" >&2
00310:     return 1
00311:   fi
00312:   local conf; conf=$(mktemp)
00313:   "$ROOT/tools/cloud-test-backend" rclone-conf > "$conf"
00314:   SSH 'mkdir -p /storage/.config/rclone' 2>/dev/null
00315:   scp -q -i "$KEY" -P "$PORT" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR "$conf" root@127.0.0.1:/storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
00316:   rm -f "$conf"
00317:   SSH "chmod 600 /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf; /usr/bin/cloud_sync_helper >/dev/null 2>&1; $(shipped_folders_cmd); echo \"vm-qa: seeded the QA remote \${r} (the guest had none)\"" 2>/dev/null
00318: }
00319: # The guest-side command that makes the shipped saves and backups folders in
00320: # the remote: their names from cloud_sync.conf.defaults, through the backend
00321: # tool, never a literal here (blindspot 71). Fails closed: a missing default
00322: # is a loud exit, not an empty folder name.
00323: shipped_folders_cmd() {
00324:   local saves backups
00325:   saves=$("$ROOT/tools/cloud-test-backend" shipped-default SAVES_REMOTE) || exit 2
00326:   backups=$("$ROOT/tools/cloud-test-backend" shipped-default SETTINGS_REMOTE) || exit 2
00327:   printf 'r=$(%s); [ -n "$r" ] || exit 1; rclone mkdir "${r}%s" >/dev/null 2>&1; rclone mkdir "${r}%s" >/dev/null 2>&1' "$ACTIVE_READER" "$saves" "$backups"
00328: }
00329: # Time to play (#135). --quick is the bounded form -- one repeat of the
00330: # launch, the exit sync and a game-to-game, no reboot and no host fixtures --
00331: # because this runs on every image and the offline and bounds cells are
00332: # minutes each. The full cell (--repeat 5, every condition) is run by hand
00333: # when a number is being proposed for a register row (D-CLOUD-116).
00334: case ",$ONLY," in *,time-to-play,*)
00335:   # Its online cells time a sync that reaches the QA cloud. In the full run
00336:   # an earlier suite has left a remote on guest a by now (run 29: reachable);
00337:   # alone (--only time-to-play) on a fresh pair there is none, and the exit
00338:   # sync ends at once with YOUR CLOUD STORAGE ISN'T SET UP YET (2026-09-25).
00339:   # tools/time-to-play now fails such a run; this keeps the suite from
00340:   # depending on its order.
00341:   ensure_remote
00342:   run_suite time-to-play "$OUT/time-to-play.log" "$ROOT/tools/time-to-play" \
00343:     --host root@127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --identity "$KEY" --monitor "$MON" \
00344:     --backend "$BACKEND" --out "$OUT/time-to-play" --quick --vm \
00345:     --label "vm-qa on $(hostname -s), guest $GUEST" ;;
00346: esac
00347: # The link cells are timing-bound (a run must end within 90 s of the cut), so
00348: # they run before the walks and never while an image builds on this host.
00349: case ",$ONLY," in *,link,*)       run_suite link       "$OUT/link.log"       "$ROOT/tools/cloud-round-trip" --host root@127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --identity "$KEY" --backend "$BACKEND" --only LINK1,LINK2,LINK3,LINK4,LINK5,LINK6,LINK7 --serial-socket "$SERIAL" ;; esac
00350: # The offline-achievements scenario (#166): the QA account on, the toggle on,
00351: # a game with a RetroAchievements set launched online, the link cut on the
00352: # monitor, an achievement unlocked and queued, the game ended offline, the
00353: # link back, the award flushed and on the account. Serial console, monitor
00354: # and the QA account file are its preconditions and each is a FAIL when
00355: # missing; a PASS spends one cheap achievement on the QA account, which is
00356: # why it is opt-in. Timing-bound like link (the flush within 90 s), so never
00357: # while an image builds here.
00358: case ",$ONLY," in *,ra-offline,*) run_suite ra-offline "$OUT/ra-offline.log" "$ROOT/tools/ra-offline-test" --host root@127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --identity "$KEY" --monitor "$MON" --serial "$SERIAL" --frames "$OUT/ra-offline-frames" ;; esac
00359: # And the transfer walks tick ROMS AND BIOS and continue to the systems page,
00360: # which on a device with no ROMs is the dialog NO SYSTEM ON THIS DEVICE HOLDS
00361: # WHAT YOU TICKED (two walks, af2db4ab09). The round-trip suite works in a
00362: # scratch tree and leaves /storage/roms as it found it -- empty on a fresh
00363: # pair -- so seed the same fixture the walks were written against: the
00364: # backend's seed-content in the cloud and seed-device's ROMs on the guest.
00365: # The manager walks want a game per system with a capture to show (#252): a
00366: # NES game with a turn recorded beside its states (the record saying the turn
00367: # came from the game's own launch, or the fixed reader ignores it -- #288), a
00368: # Game Boy game as it is,
00369: # and an FBNeo game the core's own table turns. Stub ROMs, the fixture
00370: # pictures under tools/vm-walks/fixtures/ (a ring that is round only at the
00371: # right aspect, a green mark on the edge that is the game's top), and fixed
00372: # mtimes, so the tile dates read the same on every run and the frames compare.
00373: ensure_manager_fixture() {
00374:   # match-dialog deliberately deletes the device-only GB ROMs. A surviving
00375:   # FBNeo thumbnail says nothing about the later Game Boy fixture (#455).
00376:   SSH 'test -f /storage/roms/savestates/fbn/mspacman.state.auto.png && test -f /storage/roms/nes/Bobl.nes && test -f /storage/roms/gb/Ninoid.gb && test -f /storage/roms/fbneo/mspacman.zip' 2>/dev/null && return 0
00377:   local F="$ROOT/tools/vm-walks/fixtures" put
00378:   put() { scp -q -i "$KEY" -P "$PORT" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR "$1" "root@127.0.0.1:$2"; }
00379:   SSH 'mkdir -p /storage/roms/nes /storage/roms/gb /storage/roms/fbneo /storage/roms/savestates/nes /storage/roms/savestates/gb /storage/roms/savestates/fbn /storage/roms/screenshots; for f in nes/Bobl.nes gb/Ninoid.gb fbneo/mspacman.zip; do head -c 4096 /dev/urandom > /storage/roms/$f; done; for s in nes/Bobl gb/Ninoid fbn/mspacman; do head -c 4096 /dev/urandom > /storage/roms/savestates/$s.state.auto; done; printf "turns=1\nfrom=checked-launch\n" > /storage/roms/savestates/nes/Bobl.rotation' 2>/dev/null
00380:   put "$F/nes-256x240-right.png" /storage/roms/savestates/nes/Bobl.state.auto.png
00381:   put "$F/gb-160x144.png" /storage/roms/savestates/gb/Ninoid.state.auto.png
00382:   put "$F/arcade-vertical-raw-left.png" /storage/roms/savestates/fbn/mspacman.state.auto.png
00383:   put "$F/nes-256x240-right.png" /storage/roms/screenshots/Bobl-260901-120000.png
00384:   put "$F/gb-160x144.png" /storage/roms/screenshots/Ninoid-260901-120100.png
00385:   put "$F/arcade-vertical-raw-left.png" /storage/roms/screenshots/mspacman-260901-120200.png
00386:   SSH 'touch -d "2026-09-01 12:00:00" /storage/roms/savestates/*/* /storage/roms/screenshots/* /storage/roms/nes/* /storage/roms/gb/* /storage/roms/fbneo/*; sync; echo "walks: seeded the manager fixture (nes with a turn recorded, gb as is, fbn from the core table; mtimes 2026-09-01 12:00)"' 2>/dev/null
00387: }
00388: ensure_fixture() {
00389:   ensure_remote
00390:   SSH 'test -f /storage/roms/snes/shared.sfc' 2>/dev/null && return 0
00391:   # The transfer walks upload the device-only ROMs, and the cloud keeps them:
00392:   # a second run then frames a systems page and a phase line that count what
00393:   # the first run left there (runs 17 and 18, 2026-09-23). The frame-diff
00394:   # suite compares those frames, so the endpoint is put back to the seed
00395:   # every time the guest is seeded, the way the round-trip suite does before
00396:   # its own work.
00397:   "$ROOT/tools/cloud-test-backend" reset >/dev/null 2>&1
00398:   "$ROOT/tools/cloud-test-backend" seed-content >/dev/null 2>&1
00399:   local scr; scr=$(mktemp)
00400:   "$ROOT/tools/cloud-test-backend" seed-device > "$scr"
00401:   scp -q -i "$KEY" -P "$PORT" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR "$scr" root@127.0.0.1:/tmp/qa-seed-device.sh
00402:   rm -f "$scr"
00403:   SSH 'bash /tmp/qa-seed-device.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f /tmp/qa-seed-device.sh; echo "walks: seeded the content fixture (cloud seed-content, device ROMs) -- the guest had no ROMs"' 2>/dev/null
00404:   # The shipped saves and backups folders beside the content, since the reset
00405:   # took them: RESTORE FROM THE CLOUD's scan (D-CLOUD-167) reaches the options
00406:   # page only when the cloud has the saves folder; without it the walk ends
00407:   # on the offer to create one (D-CLOUD-161), which guest d's proofs cover.
00408:   SSH "$(shipped_folders_cmd)" 2>/dev/null
00409: }
00410: # Folder navigation must not rewrite pointers/credentials or move payloads.
00411: # These guests and their endpoint are synthetic QA fixtures only. Keep each
00412: # command's result before sorting; a failed listing is not an empty witness.
00413: folder_walk_witness() {
00414:   local dest=$1 rc=0
00415:   mkdir -p "$dest"
00416:   SSH 'sha256sum /storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf && stat -c "%a %n" /storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf' > "$dest/config.txt" || rc=1
00417:   SSH '/usr/bin/cloud_setup --validation-context' > "$dest/paths.json" || rc=1
00418:   SSH "bash -o pipefail -c 'find /storage/roms -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -r sha256sum'" > "$dest/local.unsorted" || rc=1
00419:   SSH "r=\$($ACTIVE_READER); [ -n \"\$r\" ] || exit 1; timeout 60 rclone hashsum SHA256 --download --retries 1 --contimeout 5s --timeout 10s \"\$r\"" > "$dest/cloud.unsorted" || rc=1
00420:   LC_ALL=C sort "$dest/local.unsorted" > "$dest/local.txt" || rc=1
00421:   LC_ALL=C sort "$dest/cloud.unsorted" > "$dest/cloud.txt" || rc=1
00422:   printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$dest/result"
00423:   return "$rc"
00424: }
00425: 
00426: case ",$ONLY," in *,walks,*)
00427:   ensure_fixture
00428:   ensure_manager_fixture
00429:   # Every walk starts from a rebooted guest, which the README names as the
00430:   # one deterministic start; a boot-time dialog is dismissed with B first.
00431:   walk_all() {
00432:     local rc=0 name legs w pre defpre=""
00433:     # tools/vm-walks/suite.txt names the compositions: most walk files are a
00434:     # leg that starts on a screen an earlier leg reaches, so replaying them
00435:     # one at a time drove A presses into the carousel and counted the frames
00436:     # as a pass (#125). The old behaviour is the fallback if the file is gone.
00437:     local suite="$ROOT/tools/vm-walks/suite.txt"
00438:     if [ ! -f "$suite" ]; then
00439:       for w in "$ROOT"/tools/vm-walks/*.steps; do
00440:         name=$(basename "$w" .steps)
00441:         case "$name" in wake|reset) continue ;; esac
00442:         printf '%s = %s\n' "$name" "$name"
00443:       done > "$OUT/walks/suite.txt"
00444:       suite="$OUT/walks/suite.txt"
00445:     fi
00446:     while IFS= read -r line; do
00447:       line=${line%%#*}
00448:       case "$line" in *=*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
00449:       name=$(echo "${line%%=*}" | tr -d ' ')
00450:       legs=${line#*=}
00451:       # `<name> = <legs> | <shell>`: the part after | is a command run on the
00452:       # guest BEFORE the reboot, for a walk whose starting screen depends on
00453:       # state a reboot does not clear -- which the transfer page's switches
00454:       # are: EmulationStation saves them into system.cfg when the page
00455:       # closes and restores them at the next start, so a `tick-*` leg, which
00456:       # FLIPS rather than sets, went the wrong way after any walk that had
00457:       # left one on (#125).
00458:       pre=""
00459:       case "$legs" in *\|*) pre=${legs#*|}; legs=${legs%%|*} ;; esac
00460:       # `default-pre = <shell>` is the reset every walk wants; a line's own
00461:       # `| <shell>` runs after it, so a walk can override what it set.
00462:       if [ "$name" = "default-pre" ]; then defpre=$legs; continue; fi
00463:       [ -n "$name" ] || continue
00464:       if [ -n "$WALKS" ]; then
00465:         case ",$WALKS," in *,"$name",*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
00466:       fi
00467:       mkdir -p "$OUT/walks"
00468:       [ -n "$defpre" ] && SSH "$defpre" >/dev/null 2>&1
00469:       [ -n "$pre" ] && SSH "$pre" >/dev/null 2>&1
00470:       case "$name" in manager-*)
00471:         ensure_manager_fixture || { echo "walk $name: fixture failed"; rc=1; continue; }
00472:         SSH 'mkdir -p /storage/.config/emulationstation/scripts/system-selected; rm -f /storage/.cache/vm-qa-selected-system' || { rc=1; continue; }
00473:         scp -q -i "$KEY" -P "$PORT" $SSHO "$ROOT/tools/vm-walks/fixtures/system-selected.sh" "root@127.0.0.1:/storage/.config/emulationstation/scripts/system-selected/99-vm-qa.sh" || { rc=1; continue; }
00474:         SSH 'chmod 700 /storage/.config/emulationstation/scripts/system-selected/99-vm-qa.sh' || { rc=1; continue; }
00475:         ;; esac
00476:       SSH 'systemctl reboot' 2>/dev/null; sleep 6
00477:       for i in $(seq 1 45); do SSH 'pgrep -x emulationstation >/dev/null' 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 3; done; sleep 10
00478:       case "$name" in manager-*)
00479:         SSH 'curl -fsS -m 10 http://127.0.0.1:1234/systems' > "$OUT/walks/$name-systems.json"
00480:         selected_system=$(SSH 'cat /storage/.cache/vm-qa-selected-system' 2>/dev/null)
00481:         printf '%s\n' "$selected_system" > "$OUT/walks/$name-selected.txt"
00482:         SSH 'rm -f /storage/.config/emulationstation/scripts/system-selected/99-vm-qa.sh'
00483:         "$ROOT/tools/vm-manager-system-check" "${name#manager-}" "$selected_system" < "$OUT/walks/$name-systems.json" \
00484:           > "$OUT/walks/$name-system-check.log" 2>&1 \
00485:           || { echo "walk $name: requested system was not selected (see $name-system-check.log)"; rc=1; continue; }
00486:         ;; esac
00487:       case "$name" in to-change-cloud-folder|confirm-cloud-folder)
00488:         folder_walk_witness "$OUT/walks/$name-before" || { echo "walk $name: initial preservation witness failed"; rc=1; continue; }
00489:         ;; esac
00490:       # wake, then dismiss-dialogs: the first key after a boot is eaten by the
00491:       # screensaver, and a boot-time dialog (the journey prompt, the
00492:       # RetroAchievements offer, FINISH RESTORE SETUP) has to go before any
00493:       # walk. This was `key z` + `wait 2`, which is one B press: on a guest
00494:       # with nothing open that press OPENS the carousel's GO TO dialog, and
00495:       # the walk then ran a screen out of phase (#125).
00496:       { printf 'wake\ndismiss-dialogs\n'
00497:         for w in $legs; do printf '# --- %s ---\n' "$w"; cat "$ROOT/tools/vm-walks/$w.steps"; done
00498:       } | timeout 900 "$ROOT/tools/vm-visual-qa" --monitor "$MON" run - --outdir "$OUT/walks/$name/" > "$OUT/walks/$name.log" 2>&1 \
00499:         || { echo "walk $name: exit $?  (see walks/$name.log)"; rc=1; }
00500:       case "$name" in to-change-cloud-folder|confirm-cloud-folder)
00501:         if folder_walk_witness "$OUT/walks/$name-after"; then
00502:           for witness in config.txt paths.json local.txt cloud.txt; do
00503:             cmp "$OUT/walks/$name-before/$witness" "$OUT/walks/$name-after/$witness" || { echo "walk $name: preservation FAIL ($witness)"; rc=1; }
00504:           done
00505:         else
00506:           echo "walk $name: final preservation witness failed"; rc=1
00507:         fi
00508:         ;; esac
00509:       echo "walk $name: $(ls "$OUT/walks/$name/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l) frames  [$(echo $legs)]"
00510:     done < "$suite"
00511:     return $rc
00512:   }
00513:   run_suite walks "$OUT/walks.log" walk_all ;; esac
00514: # The walk frames against the last cut the maintainer accepted (#252): every
00515: # box of differing pixels outside tools/vm-walks/masks.txt must be inside a
00516: # claim in tools/vm-walks/claims.txt, or the suite fails. No baseline is a
00517: # SKIP the table shows, never a quiet pass -- accept one with
00518: #   tools/frame-diff accept <run>/walks <baseline> --build <id>
00519: # once a cut is on the device. WALK_BASELINE overrides the directory.
00520: frame_diff_suite() {
00521:   local base="${WALK_BASELINE:-$(dirname "$OUT")/walk-baseline}"
00522:   if [ ! -f "$base/BASELINE.txt" ]; then
00523:     echo "frame-diff: no baseline at $base -- accept one: tools/frame-diff accept <run>/walks $base --build <id>"; return 3
00524:   fi

00001: #!/bin/bash
00002: # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
00003: # Copyright (C) 2026-present ROCKNIX (https://github.com/ROCKNIX)
00004: #
00005: # vm-upgrade-rehearsal -- the upgrade path, rehearsed in a VM before a handheld
00006: # takes it (upgrade-and-install.md: "boot a VM from the previous image, use it
00007: # enough to create state, then update it in place and confirm that state still
00008: # works").
00009: #
00010: #   tools/vm-upgrade-rehearsal <previous ROCKNIX-GENERIC_X64...img.gz> <new ROCKNIX-GENERIC_X64...tar> <expected new BUILD_ID prefix>
00011: #
00012: # Boots vm-pair's guest a from the previous image, seeds state a player would
00013: # have -- an auto save and two numbered save states, a battery save, a
00014: # setting, a marker file, a linked cloud (the local QA backend) with a saves
00015: # remote, and a settings backup -- then puts the new tar in /storage/.update,
00016: # reboots, and checks every piece against what was seeded. Every check is a
00017: # PASS/FAIL line; the exit code is 0 only when all pass. The fixture asserts
00018: # its own seeding before the step under test, so a fixture fault cannot be
00019: # booked to the build (2026-09-20, generic-x64-vm-testing.md).
00020: #
00021: # Output: a directory under /workspace/artifacts/rocknix-images/ named
00022: # qa-<new>-upgrade-from-<old>-<stamp>/ with rehearsal.log, the post-update
00023: # journal errors, and rc.
00024: set -u
00025: OLD=${1:?previous image (.img.gz)}; NEW=${2:?new update tar}; WANT=${3:?expected new BUILD_ID prefix}
00026: [ -f "$OLD" ] || { echo "no such image: $OLD" >&2; exit 2; }
00027: [ -f "$NEW" ] || { echo "no such tar: $NEW" >&2; exit 2; }
00028: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
00029: OLDID=$(basename "$(dirname "$OLD")" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{10}$' || echo previous)   # the artifact directories end in the BUILD_ID
00030: OUT=/workspace/artifacts/rocknix-images/qa-${WANT}-upgrade-from-${OLDID}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M); mkdir -p "$OUT"
00031: LOG=$OUT/rehearsal.log; : > "$LOG"
00032: say(){ echo "=== $(date -u '+%H:%M:%S') $*" | tee -a "$LOG"; }
00033: ssha(){ ./tools/vm-pair ssh a ". /etc/profile >/dev/null 2>&1; $*" 2>>"$LOG"; }
00034: fail=0
00035: check(){ if [ "$2" = "$3" ]; then echo "PASS $1" | tee -a "$LOG"; else echo "FAIL $1: got '$2' want '$3'" | tee -a "$LOG"; fail=1; fi; }
00036: 
00037: # SSH answers before autostart has mounted the ROM tree. Readiness belongs to
00038: # the current boot, before seeding or reading retained state (#546).
00039: wait_for_storage() {
00040:   local expected_boot=$1 observed i
00041:   [ -n "$expected_boot" ] || { echo 'FAIL storage readiness: no boot identity' | tee -a "$LOG"; return 1; }
00042:   for i in $(seq 1 30); do
00043:     observed=$(ssha 'echo "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id) $(systemctl is-active rocknix-autostart.service)"' 2>/dev/null)
00044:     if [ "$observed" = "$expected_boot active" ]; then
00045:       echo "PASS storage ready in boot $expected_boot after $i poll(s)" | tee -a "$LOG"
00046:       return 0
00047:     fi
00048:     [ "$observed" = "$expected_boot failed" ] && break
00049:     sleep 2
00050:   done
00051:   echo "FAIL storage readiness: expected $expected_boot active, got ${observed:-no answer}" | tee -a "$LOG"
00052:   return 1
00053: }
00054: 
00055: say "backend: $(./tools/cloud-test-backend status 2>&1 | head -1)"; ./tools/cloud-test-backend up >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
00056: say "pair up from $(basename "$OLD")"
00057: ./tools/vm-pair up "$OLD" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { say "vm-pair up FAILED"; echo 1 > "$OUT/rc"; exit 1; }
00058: for i in $(seq 1 40); do ssha 'echo ok' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^ok$' && break; sleep 10; done
00059: BID0=$(ssha 'grep ^BUILD_ID= /etc/os-release | cut -d\" -f2'); echo "old build id: $BID0" | tee -a "$LOG"; check "old build id read" "$([ -n "$BID0" ] && echo yes)" "yes"
00060: 
00061: SEED_BOOT=$(ssha 'cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id')

00066: head -c 300000 /dev/urandom > /storage/roms/savestates/nes/Rehearsal.state.auto
00067: head -c 200000 /dev/urandom > /storage/roms/savestates/nes/Rehearsal.state1
00068: head -c 100000 /dev/urandom > /storage/roms/savestates/nes/Rehearsal.state2

00071: set_setting rehearsal.marker '"$WANT"'; sync' >>"$LOG" 2>&1

00097: BK0=$(ssha 'ls /storage/roms/backup/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l'); echo "backups before: $BK0" >> "$LOG"

00101: # into /storage, and 097-disable-rescue-completely masked emergency.target
00102: # into /storage/.config/system.d; a guest that ran them keeps them across an

00183: def response_head(

00268: class ThreadingTCPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, socketserver.TCPServer):
00269:     allow_reuse_address = True
00270:     daemon_threads = True
00271: 
00272: 
00273: class ProxyRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
00274:     server: "ProxyRuntimeServer"
00275: 
00276:     def setup(self) -> None:
00277:         super().setup()
00278:         self.request.settimeout(SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
00279: 
00280:     def do_GET(self) -> None:
00281:         self._handle_request()
00282: 
00283:     def do_POST(self) -> None:
00284:         self._handle_request()
00285: 
00286:     def log_message(self, format: str, *args) -> None:
00287:         LOGGER.debug(format, *args)
00288: 
00289:     def _handle_request(self) -> None:
00290:         if self.client_address[0] not in {"127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
00291:             self.wfile.write(error_json(403, "loopback_only"))
00292:             return
00293: 
00294:         if self.command not in {"GET", "POST"}:
00295:             self.wfile.write(error_json(405, "method not allowed"))
00296:             return
00297: 
00298:         content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0") or "0")
00299:         if content_length > MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES:
00300:             self.wfile.write(error_json(413, "request body too large"))
00301:             return
00302: 
00303:         body = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode("utf-8") if content_length else ""
00304:         headers = {key: value for key, value in self.headers.items()}
00305: 
00306:         # ROCKNIX (fork #199, #242): is_online() probes on every call while
00307:         # the tracker says unreachable, and the log line is not worth a
00308:         # probe for any request: it reads the state as last probed. The
00309:         # request's own path asks is_online() below where the answer decides
00310:         # something. Before #242 every dorequest.php call paid a probe here
00311:         # -- twenty seconds of name lookup on a link with no DNS -- before it
00312:         # was even logged, which is how the interface's fifteen-second wait
00313:         # for a store-only answer ran out on the RG35XX SP.
00314:         online = is_retroachievements_reachable()
00315:         LOGGER.info(
00316:             "Request: %s %s body=%s online=%s",
00317:             self.command,
00318:             redact_query_tokens(self.path),
00319:             redact_form_tokens(body),
00320:             online,
00321:         )
00322: 
00323:         response = self.server.process_proxy_request(
00324:             self.command, self.path, body, headers
00325:         )
00326:         self.wfile.write(response)
00327:         self.wfile.flush()
00328:         # Close gracefully (FIN, not RST): shut down the write side and let
00329:         # the client finish reading before the socket is torn down, rather
00330:         # than an abrupt close that can reset the connection out from under
00331:         # a client still draining its receive buffer.
00332:         try:
00333:             self.connection.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
00334:         except OSError:
00335:             pass
00336: 
00337: 
00338: class ProxyRuntimeServer(ThreadingTCPServer):
00339:     def __init__(self, config_data: dict, storage: Storage):
00340:         self.config_data = dict(config_data)
00341:         self.storage = storage
00342:         self.running = True
00343:         self.has_internet = False
00344:         self.activity = GameActivityTracker()
00345:         self.flush_lock = threading.Lock()
00346:         self.pending_award_lock = threading.Lock()
00347:         host = proxy_host(self.config_data)
00348:         port = proxy_port(self.config_data)
00349:         inherited = adopt_listen_socket()
00350:         super().__init__(
00351:             (host, port),
00352:             ProxyRequestHandler,
00353:             bind_and_activate=inherited is None,
00354:         )
00355:         if inherited is not None:
00356:             self.socket.close()
00357:             self.socket = inherited
00358:             self.server_address = self.socket.getsockname()

00400:     def process_proxy_request(

00409:                 # 404 at once -- no probe, no upstream attempt -- when the
00410:                 # client asked for the store only, or when this process's own
00411:                 # state is offline: the tracker as the monitor last left it,
00412:                 # the same state online_state.json carries. is_online() is not
00413:                 # asked on that path: while the tracker says unreachable it
00414:                 # probes on every call, and the fetch behind a yes is ten
00415:                 # seconds more on a link that is up and leads nowhere. A miss
00416:                 # while the state is online fetches and caches as before.
00417:                 if store_only_requested(headers) or not is_retroachievements_reachable():
00418:                     return image_not_cached()

00420:                     return self._forward_static_asset(path, headers)
00421:             return raw_response_bytes(204, b"", "application/octet-stream", "No Content")
00422: 
00423:         user_agent = headers.get("User-Agent") or headers.get("user-agent")
00424:         if user_agent:
00425:             self.storage.upsert_cache(cache_keys.USER_AGENT, user_agent)
00426: 
00427:         action = extract_action(path, raw_body)
00428:         self.note_game_request(path, raw_body)
00429:         if action in LAST_PLAYED_ACTIONS:
00430:             self.record_game_activity(path, raw_body)
00431: 
00432:         if action in AWARD_ACTIONS:
00433:             return self.handle_award_request(path, raw_body, headers)
00434: 
00435:         if action == "unlocks" and not self.is_online():
00436:             game_id = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "g")
00437:             user = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "u")
00438:             if game_id and user:
00439:                 return ok_json(self.build_offline_unlocks_response(int(game_id), user))
00440: 
00441:         if action == "startsession" and not self.is_online():
00442:             return self.handle_start_session(path, raw_body)
00443: 
00444:         if is_hardcore_request(path, raw_body):
00445:             if not self.is_online():
00446:                 return error_json(503, "upstream unavailable")
00447:             return self.forward_to_upstream(method, path, raw_body, headers)
00448: 
00449:         if action in FAKE_OFFLINE_SUCCESS_ACTIONS and not self.is_online():
00450:             return ok_json('{"Success":true}')
00451: 
00452:         if action in ALWAYS_TRY_UPSTREAM_ACTIONS:
00453:             upstream = self.forward_to_upstream_result(method, path, raw_body, headers)
00454:             if upstream[0] in {"success", "http_error"}:
00455:                 status_code = upstream[1]
00456:                 reason = upstream[2]
00457:                 response_body_bytes = upstream[3]
00458:                 content_type = upstream[4]
00459:                 response_body = upstream[5]
00460:                 if response_body is not None and should_cache_response(response_body):
00461:                     proxy_base_url = self._proxy_base_url()
00462:                     rewritten_body, downloads = rewrite_image_urls(action, response_body, proxy_base_url)
00463:                     if image_caching_enabled(self.config_data):
00464:                         _start_image_downloads(downloads, user_agent, None)
00465:                     key = cache_key_for_request(path, raw_body)
00466:                     # Store the original body — the DB stays port-agnostic.
00467:                     self.storage.upsert_cache(key, response_body)
00468:                     response_body_bytes = rewritten_body.encode("utf-8")
00469:                 return raw_response_bytes(
00470:                     status_code, response_body_bytes, content_type, reason
00471:                 )
00472:             cached_login_response = self.handle_offline_login(path, raw_body, action)
00473:             if cached_login_response is not None:
00474:                 return cached_login_response
00475: 
00476:         # ROCKNIX (fork #190): a client that wants the store and nothing else
00477:         # -- the interface's pages, which show the device's copy -- says so
00478:         # with X-RA-Store-Only: 1 and is answered from the store whatever this
00479:         # process believes about the link. While it still believes it is
00480:         # online (the monitor probes every fifteen seconds), every request
00481:         # first tries upstream with a fifteen-second timeout, and a summary
00482:         # over a few hundred games on a link that has just gone is hours.
00483:         if store_only_requested(headers):
00484:             return self.handle_offline_request(path, raw_body, action)
00485: 
00486:         if self.is_online():
00487:             return self.handle_online_request(method, path, raw_body, action, headers)
00488: 
00489:         return self.handle_offline_request(path, raw_body, action)

00491:     def handle_offline_login(
00492:         self, path: str, raw_body: str, action: str | None
00493:     ) -> bytes | None:
00494:         if action not in ALWAYS_TRY_UPSTREAM_ACTIONS:
00495:             return None
00496: 
00497:         user = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "u")
00498:         if not user:
00499:             return None
00500: 
00501:         cached = self.storage.get_cache(cache_keys.login(user))
00502:         if cached is None:
00503:             return None
00504: 
00505:         # The store's answer, given because upstream could not be reached:
00506:         # X-RA-Offline: 1 says so to a client that wants to tell the player.
00507:         return ok_json(cached["responseBody"], extra_headers=(OFFLINE_LOGIN_HEADER,))

00688:             unlock_entries, (str, bytes, bytearray)

00702:         self.storage.upsert_cache(

00710:     def handle_offline_request(
00711:         self, path: str, raw_body: str, action: str | None
00712:     ) -> bytes:
00713:         if not should_cache_action(action, path):
00714:             return error_json(503, "offline")
00715: 
00716:         if action == "unlocks":
00717:             game_id = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "g")
00718:             user = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "u")
00719:             if game_id and user:
00720:                 return ok_json(self.build_offline_unlocks_response(int(game_id), user))
00721: 
00722:         key = cache_key_for_request(path, raw_body)
00723:         cached = self.storage.get_cache(key) or self.storage.get_cache_by_prefix(
00724:             f"{key}:"
00725:         )
00726:         if cached is not None:
00727:             proxy_base_url = self._proxy_base_url()
00728:             rewritten_body, _ = rewrite_image_urls(action, cached["responseBody"], proxy_base_url)
00729:             return ok_json(filter_warning_achievements_for_action(action, rewritten_body))
00730: 
00731:         if action == "gameid":
00732:             LOGGER.warning(
00733:                 "Offline gameid cache miss requestedKey=%s sampleKeys=%s",
00734:                 key,
00735:                 self.storage.cache_keys_by_prefix(cache_keys.PREFIX_GAMEID)[:10],
00736:             )
00737:             return game_id_cache_miss()
00738: 
00739:         if action == "achievementsets":
00740:             hash_value = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "m")
00741:             fallback_game_id = extract_request_param(
00742:                 path, raw_body, "g"
00743:             ) or extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "i")
00744:             user = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "u") or ""
00745:             proxy_base_url = self._proxy_base_url()
00746:             if hash_value and user:
00747:                 cached = self.storage.get_cache(
00748:                     cache_keys.achievementsets(hash_value, user)
00749:                 )
00750:                 if cached is not None:
00751:                     rewritten_body, _ = rewrite_image_urls(action, cached["responseBody"], proxy_base_url)
00752:                     return ok_json(filter_warning_achievements_for_action(action, rewritten_body))
00753:             if fallback_game_id and user:
00754:                 cached = self.storage.get_cache(
00755:                     cache_keys.achievementsets(fallback_game_id, user)
00756:                 )
00757:                 if cached is not None:
00758:                     rewritten_body, _ = rewrite_image_urls(action, cached["responseBody"], proxy_base_url)
00759:                     return ok_json(filter_warning_achievements_for_action(action, rewritten_body))
00760: 
00761:         return error_json(503, "no cached response")

00763:     def build_offline_unlocks_response(self, game_id: int, user: str) -> str:
00764:         entry = self.storage.get_cache(cache_keys.unlocks(game_id, user))
00765:         payload: dict = {"Success": True, "UserUnlocks": []}
00766:         if entry is not None:
00767:             try:
00768:                 payload = json.loads(entry["responseBody"])
00769:             except Exception:
00770:                 payload = {"Success": True, "UserUnlocks": []}
00771: 
00772:         payload["Success"] = True
00773:         payload["UserUnlocks"] = merged_unlock_ids(self.storage, game_id, user)
00774:         return json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
00775: 
00776:     def build_offline_start_session_response(self, game_id: int, user: str) -> str:
00777:         entry = self.storage.get_cache(cache_keys.start_session(game_id, user))
00778:         server_now = int(time.time())
00779:         payload: dict = {
00780:             "Success": True,
00781:             "ServerNow": server_now,
00782:             "HardcoreUnlocks": [],
00783:         }
00784:         if entry is not None:
00785:             try:
00786:                 payload = json.loads(entry["responseBody"])
00787:             except Exception:
00788:                 payload = {
00789:                     "Success": True,
00790:                     "ServerNow": server_now,
00791:                     "HardcoreUnlocks": [],
00792:                 }
00793: 
00794:         server_now = int(payload.get("ServerNow", server_now) or server_now)
00795:         cached_start_session_unlock_ids = filter_warning_achievement_ids([
00796:             int(item.get("ID", 0))
00797:             for item in payload.get("Unlocks", [])
00798:             if isinstance(item, dict) and int(item.get("ID", 0) or 0) > 0
00799:         ])
00800:         payload["Success"] = True
00801:         payload.setdefault("HardcoreUnlocks", [])
00802:         payload["Unlocks"] = self.build_merged_start_session_unlocks(
00803:             game_id, user, server_now, cached_start_session_unlock_ids
00804:         )
00805:         return json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
00806: 
00807:     def build_merged_start_session_unlocks(
00808:         self,
00809:         game_id: int,
00810:         user: str,
00811:         server_now: int,
00812:         cached_start_session_unlock_ids: list[int],
00813:     ) -> list[dict]:
00814:         merged_ids = merged_unlock_ids(self.storage, game_id, user)
00815:         if not merged_ids:
00816:             merged_ids = list(cached_start_session_unlock_ids)
00817:         else:
00818:             seen_ids = set(merged_ids)
00819:             for achievement_id in cached_start_session_unlock_ids:
00820:                 if achievement_id <= 0 or achievement_id in seen_ids:
00821:                     continue
00822:                 merged_ids.append(achievement_id)
00823:                 seen_ids.add(achievement_id)
00824: 
00825:         return [
00826:             {"ID": achievement_id, "When": server_now} for achievement_id in merged_ids
00827:         ]

00829:     def forward_to_upstream(
00830:         self, method: str, path: str, raw_body: str, headers: dict[str, str]
00831:     ) -> bytes:
00832:         upstream = self.forward_to_upstream_result(method, path, raw_body, headers)
00833:         if upstream[0] == "success":
00834:             return raw_response_bytes(
00835:                 upstream[1], upstream[3], upstream[4], upstream[2]
00836:             )
00837:         if upstream[0] == "http_error":
00838:             return raw_response_bytes(
00839:                 upstream[1], upstream[3], upstream[4], upstream[2]
00840:             )
00841:         return error_json(503, "upstream unavailable")

00843:     def forward_to_upstream_result(
00844:         self, method: str, path: str, raw_body: str, headers: dict[str, str]
00845:     ) -> tuple[str, int, str, bytes, str | None, str | None]:
00846:         url = f"{upstream_host(self.config_data)}{path}"
00847:         request_headers = build_forward_headers(headers)
00848:         # ROCKNIX (fork #242): the lookup first, bounded, so an attempt on a
00849:         # link with no DNS fails in seconds rather than the resolver's twenty
00850:         # -- the sign-in at a game's launch tries upstream before the store,
00851:         # and RetroArch showed no achievements for as long as that took.
00852:         resolved, reason = resolve_host_bounded(urlsplit(url).hostname or "")
00853:         if not resolved:
00854:             mark_retroachievements_unreachable()
00855:             LOGGER.warning("Upstream request skipped: %s", reason)
00856:             body_text = json.dumps({"Success": False, "Error": reason})
00857:             return (
00858:                 "network_error",
00859:                 503,
00860:                 "Service Unavailable",
00861:                 body_text.encode("utf-8"),
00862:                 "application/json",
00863:                 body_text,
00864:             )
00865:         counted = path.startswith("/dorequest.php")
00866:         try:
00867:             if method == "POST":
00868:                 status, reason, response_body = http_post(
00869:                     url,
00870:                     raw_body,
00871:                     request_headers,
00872:                     usage_source=usage_stats.SOURCE_EMULATOR if counted else None,
00873:                 )
00874:                 response_bytes_body = response_body.encode("utf-8")
00875:                 content_type = "application/json"
00876:             else:
00877:                 import urllib.request
00878: 
00879:                 request = urllib.request.Request(
00880:                     url, headers=request_headers, method="GET"
00881:                 )
00882:                 responded = False
00883:                 try:
00884:                     with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
00885:                         status = response.status
00886:                         responded = True
00887:                         if counted:
00888:                             usage_stats.record_request(usage_stats.SOURCE_EMULATOR, status)
00889:                         reason = response.reason
00890:                         response_bytes_body = read_response_bytes(response)
00891:                         content_type = response_content_type(response)
00892:                         if path.startswith("/dorequest.php"):
00893:                             response_body = decode_response_body(
00894:                                 response_bytes_body, content_type
00895:                             )
00896:                         else:
00897:                             response_body = ""
00898:                 except Exception as error:
00899:                     if hasattr(error, "read"):
00900:                         status = getattr(error, "code", 500)
00901:                         if counted:
00902:                             usage_stats.record_request(usage_stats.SOURCE_EMULATOR, status)
00903:                         reason = getattr(
00904:                             error, "reason", canonical_reason_phrase(status)
00905:                         )
00906:                         response_bytes_body = error.read()
00907:                         content_type = getattr(error, "headers", {}).get("Content-Type")
00908:                         if path.startswith("/dorequest.php"):
00909:                             response_body = decode_response_body(
00910:                                 response_bytes_body, content_type
00911:                             )
00912:                         else:
00913:                             response_body = ""
00914:                     else:
00915:                         if counted and not responded:
00916:                             usage_stats.record_request(usage_stats.SOURCE_EMULATOR, None)
00917:                         raise
00918: 
00919:             if 200 <= status < 300:
00920:                 return (
00921:                     "success",
00922:                     status,
00923:                     reason,
00924:                     response_bytes_body,
00925:                     content_type,
00926:                     response_body,
00927:                 )
00928:             return (
00929:                 "http_error",
00930:                 status,
00931:                 reason,
00932:                 response_bytes_body,
00933:                 content_type,
00934:                 response_body,
00935:             )
00936:         except Exception as error:
00937:             mark_retroachievements_unreachable()
00938:             LOGGER.error("Upstream request failed: %s", error)
00939:             return (
00940:                 "network_error",
00941:                 503,
00942:                 "Service Unavailable",
00943:                 json.dumps({"Success": False, "Error": str(error)}).encode("utf-8"),
00944:                 "application/json",
00945:                 json.dumps({"Success": False, "Error": str(error)}),
00946:             )
00947: 
00948:     def queue_award(self, path: str, raw_body: str, headers: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
00949:         achievement_id = int(extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "a") or "0")
00950:         pending_award_lock = getattr(self, "pending_award_lock", None)
00951:         if pending_award_lock is None:
00952:             pending_award_lock = threading.Lock()
00953:             self.pending_award_lock = pending_award_lock
00954: 
00955:         with pending_award_lock:
00956:             if achievement_id > 0 and self.storage.pending_award_exists(achievement_id):
00957:                 LOGGER.info(
00958:                     "Offline award already queued: achievementId=%s",
00959:                     achievement_id,
00960:                 )
00961:                 return True
00962: 
00963:             if achievement_id > 0 and self.is_already_unlocked_award(path, raw_body):
00964:                 LOGGER.info(
00965:                     "Offline award already unlocked: achievementId=%s",
00966:                     achievement_id,
00967:                 )
00968:                 return True
00969: 
00970:             prev_hash = (self.storage.get_latest_pending_award() or {}).get(
00971:                 "payloadHash"
00972:             ) or "genesis"
00973:             queued_at = current_millis()
00974:             payload_hash = sha256_hex(f"{achievement_id}|{path}|{raw_body}|{queued_at}")
00975:             sign_input = f"{payload_hash}:{prev_hash}".encode("utf-8")
00976:             signature = sign_award(sign_input)
00977: 
00978:             award = {
00979:                 "achievementId": achievement_id,
00980:                 "queryString": path,
00981:                 "requestBody": raw_body,
00982:                 "userAgent": headers.get("User-Agent")
00983:                 or headers.get("user-agent")
00984:                 or FALLBACK_USER_AGENT,
00985:                 "queuedAt": queued_at,
00986:                 "retryCount": 0,
00987:                 "lastError": None,
00988:                 "status": "pending",
00989:                 "payloadHash": payload_hash,
00990:                 "prevHash": prev_hash,
00991:                 "signature": signature,
00992:                 "signedAt": current_millis(),
00993:             }
00994:             self.storage.upsert_pending_award(award)
00995:             LOGGER.info(
00996:                 "Queued offline award: achievementId=%s queuedAt=%s",
00997:                 achievement_id,
00998:                 queued_at,
00999:             )
01000:             return True
01001: 
01002:     def is_already_unlocked_award(self, path: str, raw_body: str) -> bool:
01003:         achievement_id = int(extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "a") or "0")
01004:         user = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "u")
01005:         if achievement_id <= 0 or not user:
01006:             return False
01007: 
01008:         game_id = find_achievement_game_ids(self.storage, {achievement_id}).get(achievement_id)
01009:         if game_id is None:
01010:             return False
01011: 
01012:         cached_unlocks = self.storage.get_cache(cache_keys.unlocks(game_id, user))
01013:         if cached_unlocks is None:
01014:             return False
01015: 
01016:         try:
01017:             payload = json.loads(cached_unlocks["responseBody"])
01018:         except Exception:
01019:             return False
01020: 
01021:         unlock_ids = payload.get("UserUnlocks")
01022:         if not isinstance(unlock_ids, list):
01023:             return False
01024: 
01025:         return achievement_id in filter_warning_achievement_ids(
01026:             [item for item in unlock_ids if isinstance(item, int)]
01027:         )
01028: 
01029:     def fetch_cached_score(self, path: str, raw_body: str) -> int:
01030:         user = extract_request_param(path, raw_body, "u")
01031:         if not user:
01032:             return 0
01033:         cached = self.storage.get_cache(cache_keys.login(user))
01034:         if cached is None:
01035:             return 0
01036:         try:
01037:             payload = json.loads(cached["responseBody"])
01038:             return int(payload.get("Score", 0))
01039:         except Exception:
01040:             return 0
01041: 
01042:     def flush_pending_awards(self) -> dict:
01043:         with self.flush_lock:
01044:             outcome = flush_pending_awards(self.storage, self.config_data)
01045:             if outcome.total:
01046:                 LOGGER.info(
01047:                     "Flush outcome: total=%s flushed=%s skipped_deleted=%s skipped_stale=%s pending_remaining=%s last_error=%s",
01048:                     outcome.total,
01049:                     outcome.flushed,
01050:                     outcome.skipped_deleted,
01051:                     outcome.skipped_stale,
01052:                     outcome.pending_remaining,
01053:                     outcome.last_error,
01054:                 )
01055:             return {
01056:                 "flushed": outcome.flushed,
01057:                 "total": outcome.total,
01058:                 "skipped_deleted": outcome.skipped_deleted,
01059:                 "skipped_stale": outcome.skipped_stale,
01060:                 "pending_remaining": outcome.pending_remaining,
01061:                 "last_error": outcome.last_error,
01062:             }
01063: 
01064: 
01065: def _capture_file_inodes(paths: list[Path]) -> dict[Path, int]:
01066:     inodes: dict[Path, int] = {}
01067:     for path in paths:
01068:         try:
01069:             inodes[path] = path.stat().st_ino
01070:         except OSError:
01071:             continue
01072:     return inodes
01073: 
01074: 
01075: def _files_replaced_underneath(inodes: dict[Path, int]) -> bool:
01076:     for path, inode in inodes.items():
01077:         try:
01078:             if path.stat().st_ino != inode:
01079:                 return True
01080:         except OSError:
01081:             return True
01082:     return False
01083:

01085: class ConnectivityMonitor(threading.Thread):
01086:     def __init__(self, server: ProxyRuntimeServer, interval_seconds: int = 15):
01087:         super().__init__(daemon=True)
01088:         self.server = server
01089:         self.interval_seconds = interval_seconds
01090:         self.stop_event = threading.Event()
01091:         self.watched_inodes = _capture_file_inodes([DATABASE_FILE])
01092: 
01093:     def stop(self) -> None:
01094:         self.stop_event.set()
01095: 
01096:     def run(self) -> None:
01097:         was_online = self.server.refresh_reachability(force_probe=True)
01098:         save_online_state(was_online)
01099:         while not self.stop_event.wait(self.interval_seconds):
01100:             if self.watched_inodes and _files_replaced_underneath(self.watched_inodes):
01101:                 # A reinstall deleted our log/database out from under this
01102:                 # process while it kept them open; exit so the next
01103:                 # "start proxy" spawns a fresh process against current files
01104:                 # instead of silently running as an invisible orphan.
01105:                 LOGGER.error("Data files were deleted or replaced underneath this process; exiting")
01106:                 os._exit(1)
01107:             is_online = self.server.refresh_reachability(force_probe=True)
01108:             if is_online and not was_online:
01109:                 LOGGER.info("Connectivity restored; attempting flush")
01110:                 self.server.flush_pending_awards()
01111:             if is_online != was_online:
01112:                 save_online_state(is_online)
01113:             was_online = is_online
01114:

01116: class GameActivityTracker:
01117:     # Monotonic on purpose: handhelds without an RTC battery jump their wall clock by years
01118:     # once NTP syncs, which would make a wall-clock idle timer fire or stall at random.
01119:     def __init__(self, clock=time.monotonic) -> None:
01120:         self._clock = clock
01121:         self._last_activity_at: float | None = None
01122: 
01123:     def note(self) -> None:
01124:         self._last_activity_at = self._clock()
01125: 
01126:     def idle_delay_seconds(self) -> float:
01127:         if self._last_activity_at is None:
01128:             return 0.0
01129:         elapsed = self._clock() - self._last_activity_at
01130:         return max(0.0, ONLINE_REFRESH_IDLE_DELAY_SECONDS - elapsed)
01131: 
01132: 
01133: class PeriodicRefresh(threading.Thread):
01134:     def __init__(
01135:         self,
01136:         server: ProxyRuntimeServer,
01137:         interval_seconds: int = 3600,  # 1 hour
01138:         cache_ttl_seconds: int = 60 * 24 * 3600,  # 60 days (matches Android)
01139:     ):
01140:         super().__init__(daemon=True)
01141:         self.server = server
01142:         self.interval_seconds = interval_seconds
01143:         self.cache_ttl_seconds = cache_ttl_seconds
01144:         self.stop_event = threading.Event()
01145: 
01146:     def stop(self) -> None:
01147:         self.stop_event.set()
01148: 
01149:     def run(self) -> None:
01150:         # A failed pass must not silently end the service's refresh thread.
01151:         while not self.stop_event.wait(self.interval_seconds):
01152:             try:
01153:                 self.run_pass()
01154:             except Exception:
01155:                 LOGGER.exception(
01156:                     "Periodic refresh pass failed; the next runs in %ss",
01157:                     self.interval_seconds,
01158:                 )
01159: 
01160:     def run_pass(self) -> None:
01161:         if not self.server.is_online():
01162:             return
01163:         user_agent = self_user_agent()
01164:         credentials = resolve_credentials(
01165:             self.server.storage,
01166:             self.server.config_data,
01167:             user_agent,
01168:         )
01169:         if credentials is None:
01170:             return
01171:         if rate_limit.paused_until() is not None:
01172:             LOGGER.info("Periodic refresh skipped; RetroAchievements asked to slow down")
01173:             return
01174:         if not self.wait_until_idle():
01175:             return
01176:         patch_keys = self.server.storage.cache_keys_by_prefix(cache_keys.PREFIX_PATCH)
01177:         recently_played = load_recently_played_game_ids(
01178:             self.server.storage, current_millis() - REFRESH_PLAYED_WINDOW_MS
01179:         )
01180:         due_game_ids = due_refresh_game_ids(patch_keys, recently_played)
01181:         LOGGER.info(
01182:             "Periodic refresh: %d of %d cached game(s) played in the last %d day(s)",
01183:             len(due_game_ids),
01184:             len(patch_keys),
01185:             REFRESH_PLAYED_WINDOW_DAYS,
01186:         )
01187:         with rate_limit.background():
01188:             self.refresh_games(due_game_ids, credentials, user_agent)
01189:         before = current_millis() - (self.cache_ttl_seconds * 1000)
01190:         self.server.storage.evict_cache_older_than(before)
01191: 
01192:     def wait_until_idle(self) -> bool:
01193:         idle_delay = self.server.activity.idle_delay_seconds()
01194:         if idle_delay <= 0:
01195:             return True
01196:         LOGGER.info("Periodic refresh deferred; proxy active recently")
01197:         if self.stop_event.wait(idle_delay):
01198:             return False
01199:         return self.server.is_online() and self.server.activity.idle_delay_seconds() <= 0
01200: 
01201:     def refresh_games(self, game_ids: list[int], credentials: dict, user_agent: str) -> int:
01202:         refreshed = 0
01203:         failures_in_a_row = 0
01204:         for game_id in game_ids:
01205:             if self.server.activity.idle_delay_seconds() > 0:
01206:                 LOGGER.info("Periodic refresh paused; proxy became active")
01207:                 break
01208:             try:
01209:                 refresh_game_patch(
01210:                     game_id,
01211:                     credentials,
01212:                     user_agent,
01213:                     self.server.storage,
01214:                     self.server.config_data,
01215:                     cache_images=image_caching_enabled(self.server.config_data),
01216:                 )
01217:                 cache_unlocks(
01218:                     game_id,
01219:                     credentials,
01220:                     user_agent,
01221:                     self.server.config_data,
01222:                     self.server.storage,
01223:                 )
01224:                 cache_session(game_id, credentials, self.server.storage)
01225:             except CacheGameAuthError as exc:
01226:                 LOGGER.warning("Periodic refresh: sign-in refused (%s); ending the pass", exc)
01227:                 break
01228:             except Exception as exc:
01229:                 failures_in_a_row += 1
01230:                 LOGGER.warning("Periodic refresh: game %s not refreshed: %s", game_id, exc)
01231:                 if failures_in_a_row >= REFRESH_MAX_FAILURES_IN_A_ROW:
01232:                     LOGGER.warning(
01233:                         "Periodic refresh: %d fetches failed in a row; ending the pass",
01234:                         failures_in_a_row,
01235:                     )
01236:                     break
01237:                 if rate_limit.paused_until() is not None:
01238:                     LOGGER.warning("Periodic refresh stopped; RetroAchievements answered 429")
01239:                     break
01240:                 continue
01241:             failures_in_a_row = 0
01242:             refreshed += 1
01243:             if rate_limit.paused_until() is not None:
01244:                 LOGGER.warning("Periodic refresh stopped; RetroAchievements answered 429")
01245:                 break
01246:         return refreshed
01247: 
01248: 
01249: class UsageReporter(threading.Thread):
01250:     """Checks shortly after start and then every 15 minutes, so a device whose proxy autostarts
01251:     and whose menu is never opened still reports once per UTC day."""
01252: 
01253:     def __init__(
01254:         self,
01255:         server: ProxyRuntimeServer,
01256:         initial_delay_seconds: int = 60,
01257:         interval_seconds: int = 15 * 60,
01258:     ):
01259:         super().__init__(daemon=True)
01260:         self.server = server
01261:         self.initial_delay_seconds = initial_delay_seconds
01262:         self.interval_seconds = interval_seconds
01263:         self.stop_event = threading.Event()
01264: 
01265:     def stop(self) -> None:
01266:         self.stop_event.set()
01267: 
01268:     def run(self) -> None:
01269:         delay = self.initial_delay_seconds
01270:         while not self.stop_event.wait(delay):
01271:             delay = self.interval_seconds
01272:             if self.server.is_online():
01273:                 usage_report.report_if_due(self.server.storage)
01274:
