00160: class _FileLock:
00161:     """A lock shared by every process on the device: the menu, the CLI and the proxy service
00162:     each open their own Storage, but drain one queue within one budget."""
00163: 
00164:     def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
00165:         self.path = path
00166: 
00167:     @contextlib.contextmanager
00168:     def hold(self, shared: bool = False, blocking: bool = True, should_abort=None):
00169:         ensure_config_dir()
00170:         with self.path.open("a+") as handle:
00171:             held = _HeldLock(handle, shared, self._acquire(handle, shared, blocking, should_abort))
00172:             try:
00173:                 yield held
00174:             finally:
00175:                 if held:
00176:                     _unlock(handle)
00177: 
00178:     def held_elsewhere(self) -> bool:
00179:         with self.hold(blocking=False) as acquired:
00180:             return not acquired
00181: 
00182:     @staticmethod
00183:     def _acquire(handle, shared: bool, blocking: bool, should_abort) -> bool:
00184:         if fcntl is None:
00185:             return True
00186:         mode = (fcntl.LOCK_SH if shared else fcntl.LOCK_EX) | fcntl.LOCK_NB
00187:         while True:
00188:             try:
00189:                 fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), mode)
00190:                 return True
00191:             except OSError:
00192:                 if not blocking or (should_abort is not None and should_abort()):
00193:                     return False
00194:                 time.sleep(LOCK_POLL_SECONDS)
00195: 
00196: 
00197: class _HeldLock:
00198:     """What hold() yields: true while the lock is held."""
00199: 
00200:     def __init__(self, handle, shared: bool, acquired: bool) -> None:
00201:         self.handle = handle
00202:         self.shared = shared
00203:         self.acquired = acquired
00204: 
00205:     def __bool__(self) -> bool:
00206:         return self.acquired
00207: 
00208:     @contextlib.contextmanager
00209:     def released(self, should_abort=None):
00210:         """Lets other callers take the lock meanwhile, then waits to take it back; afterwards
00211:         the lock is false when should_abort gave up on that."""
00212:         _unlock(self.handle)
00213:         self.acquired = False
00214:         try:
00215:             yield
00216:         finally:
00217:             self.acquired = _FileLock._acquire(self.handle, self.shared, True, should_abort)
00218: 
00219: 
00220: def _unlock(handle) -> None:
00221:     if fcntl is not None:
00222:         fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
00223: 
00224: 
00225: # Only one caller drains at a time: a bulk run's first batch waits for it, the service's worker
00226: # skips its round.
00227: drain_lock = _FileLock(DRAIN_LOCK_FILE)
00228: # Held (shared) for a whole drain, also while it waits for its pace with drain_lock released.
00229: draining_lock = _FileLock(DRAINING_LOCK_FILE)
00230: # Held (shared) while a bulk run hashes and runs its first batch; the service's worker stands
00231: # down meanwhile so it never drains a queue that is still filling.
00232: bulk_run_lock = _FileLock(BULK_RUN_LOCK_FILE)
00233:

00235: def draining_elsewhere() -> bool:
00236:     return draining_lock.held_elsewhere()

00001: from __future__ import annotations

00003: import contextlib
00004: import threading
00005: import time
00006: 
00007: RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000
00008: 
00009: _lock = threading.Lock()
00010: _paused_until = 0
00011: _local = threading.local()
00012: 
00013: 
00014: class RateLimitedError(RuntimeError):
00015:     pass
00016: 
00017: 
00018: def current_millis() -> int:
00019:     return int(time.time() * 1000)
00020: 
00021: 
00022: def in_background() -> bool:
00023:     """True while the cache queue or the periodic refresh sends requests on this thread: a 429
00024:     then stops that work instead of being retried."""
00025:     return getattr(_local, "depth", 0) > 0
00026: 
00027: 
00028: @contextlib.contextmanager
00029: def background():
00030:     _local.depth = getattr(_local, "depth", 0) + 1
00031:     try:
00032:         yield
00033:     finally:
00034:         _local.depth -= 1
00035: 
00036: 
00037: def on_rate_limited(retry_after_ms: int | None, now: int | None = None) -> None:
00038:     """Pauses background work for at least ten minutes, longer if the server's Retry-After asks."""
00039:     global _paused_until
00040:     until = (now if now is not None else current_millis()) + max(
00041:         RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE_MS, retry_after_ms or 0
00042:     )
00043:     with _lock:
00044:         _paused_until = max(_paused_until, until)
00045: 
00046: 
00047: def paused_until(now: int | None = None) -> int | None:
00048:     current = now if now is not None else current_millis()
00049:     with _lock:
00050:         return _paused_until if _paused_until > current else None
00051: 
00052: 
00053: def reset_for_tests() -> None:
00054:     global _paused_until
00055:     with _lock:
00056:         _paused_until = 0

00055:                     action or "unknown",

00219:     user_agent: str | None = None,
00220:     force: bool = False,
00221:     now: float | None = None,
00222: ) -> bool:
00223:     current_time = now if now is not None else time.monotonic()
00224:     if not should_probe_retroachievements(force=force, now=current_time):
00225:         return is_retroachievements_reachable()
00226: 
00227:     if not has_active_network_interface():
00228:         _log_probe_failure("no active network interface")
00229:         mark_retroachievements_unreachable(current_time)
00230:         return False
00231: 
00232:     upstream = upstream_host(config_data)
00233:     parsed = urlsplit(upstream)
00234:     url = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}/"
00235:     # Only forced probes (startup, background monitor) retry: request-path probes run
00236:     # on every request while unreachable and must not stall the emulator.
00237:     attempts = PROBE_ATTEMPTS if force else 1
00238:     reason = "unknown"
00239:     for attempt in range(attempts):
00240:         if attempt > 0:
00241:             time.sleep(PROBE_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS)
00242:         reachable, reason = _head_upstream(url, user_agent)
00243:         if reachable:
00244:             mark_retroachievements_reachable(current_time)
00245:             return True
00246: 
00247:     _log_probe_failure(reason)
00248:     mark_retroachievements_unreachable(current_time)
00249:     return False
00250: 
00251: 
00252: # ROCKNIX (audit #308 F-RA-20): the answer the bounded lookup got, kept for
00253: # the connection that follows. The lookup is bounded, and then the request
00254: # opens its connection by name -- a second lookup, which nothing bounded and
00255: # nothing caches on a handheld (no nscd): a resolver that answered once and
00256: # stopped would hold the request for the twenty seconds the first lookup is
00257: # bounded against. So socket.getaddrinfo answers a host the bounded lookup
00258: # resolved in the last REMEMBER_SECONDS from that answer (the port and the
00259: # socket type the caller asks for put in); every other lookup, and the
00260: # bounded lookup itself -- which asks the resolver every time, so it stays
00261: # the probe it was -- goes to the resolver as before.
00262: REMEMBER_SECONDS = 30.0
00263: _remembered: dict[str, tuple[float, list]] = {}
00264: _remembered_lock = threading.Lock()
00265: _asking_resolver = threading.local()
00266: # The resolver's own function, even when this module is loaded a second time.
00267: _resolver_getaddrinfo = getattr(socket.getaddrinfo, "__wrapped__", socket.getaddrinfo)
00268: 
00269: 
00270: def _getaddrinfo_remembering(host, port, family=0, type=0, proto=0, flags=0):
00271:     if isinstance(host, str) and not getattr(_asking_resolver, "active", False):
00272:         with _remembered_lock:
00273:             entry = _remembered.get(host.lower())
00274:         if entry is not None and time.monotonic() - entry[0] < REMEMBER_SECONDS:
00275:             try:
00276:                 number = 0 if port is None else int(port)
00277:             except (TypeError, ValueError):
00278:                 number = None
00279:             answer = []
00280:             for fam, kind, prot, canon, address in entry[1] if number is not None else ():
00281:                 if family and fam != family:
00282:                     continue
00283:                 if type and kind and kind != type:
00284:                     continue
00285:                 if proto and prot and prot != proto:
00286:                     continue
00287:                 item = (fam, kind or type, prot or proto, canon, (address[0], number, *address[2:]))
00288:                 if item not in answer:
00289:                     answer.append(item)
00290:             if answer:
00291:                 return answer
00292:     return _resolver_getaddrinfo(host, port, family, type, proto, flags)
00293: 
00294: 
00295: _getaddrinfo_remembering.__wrapped__ = _resolver_getaddrinfo
00296: socket.getaddrinfo = _getaddrinfo_remembering
00297: 
00298: 
00299: def resolve_host_bounded(host: str, seconds: float = LOOKUP_SECONDS) -> tuple[bool, str]:
00300:     """Look the host up in a thread of its own and give it `seconds`.
00301: 
00302:     ROCKNIX (fork #242). (True, "") when the name resolved in time; (False,
00303:     why) when it did not or could not. A lookup still running when the time
00304:     is up is left to finish on its own daemon thread; the answer it was going
00305:     to give is "unreachable" either way, and the caller must not wait for it.
00306:     The resolver is asked every time, and a lookup that succeeded is kept for
00307:     REMEMBER_SECONDS, so the connection that follows is answered from it
00308:     rather than by a second lookup nothing bounds (audit #308 F-RA-20).
00309:     """
00310:     if not host:
00311:         return False, "no host to look up"
00312:     result: dict[str, str | bool] = {}
00313: 
00314:     def work() -> None:
00315:         _asking_resolver.active = True
00316:         try:
00317:             answer = socket.getaddrinfo(host, None)
00318:             with _remembered_lock:
00319:                 _remembered[host.lower()] = (time.monotonic(), list(answer))
00320:             result["ok"] = True
00321:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - every resolver error is the same answer
00322:             result["error"] = str(error)
00323: 
00324:     thread = threading.Thread(target=work, name="ra-name-lookup", daemon=True)
00325:     thread.start()
00326:     thread.join(seconds)
00327:     if thread.is_alive():
00328:         return False, f"name lookup of {host} took longer than {seconds:g} s"
00329:     if result.get("ok"):
00330:         return True, ""
00331:     return False, f"name lookup of {host} failed: {result.get('error', 'unknown')}"
00332: 
00333: 
00334: def _head_upstream(url: str, user_agent: str | None) -> tuple[bool, str]:
00335:     # ROCKNIX (fork #242): the lookup first, bounded; the HEAD's own timeout
00336:     # starts only once there is an address to connect to.
00337:     resolved, reason = resolve_host_bounded(urlsplit(url).hostname or "")
00338:     if not resolved:
00339:         return False, reason
00340:     request = urllib.request.Request(
00341:         url,
00342:         headers={
00343:             "User-Agent": proxy_user_agent(user_agent or FALLBACK_USER_AGENT),
00344:             "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
00345:         },
00346:         method="HEAD",
00347:     )
00348:     try:
00349:         with urllib.request.urlopen(
00350:             request, timeout=5, context=configured_ssl_context()
00351:         ) as response:
00352:             if 200 <= response.status < 500:
00353:                 return True, ""
00354:             return False, f"HTTP {response.status}"
00355:     except Exception as error:
00356:         return False, str(error)

00359: def _log_probe_failure(reason: str) -> None:
00360:     # Only on the way from reachable to unreachable: a device that stays offline
00361:     # probes every 15s and would otherwise fill the log with the same line.
00362:     reachable, checked_at = _reachability_tracker.current()
00363:     if checked_at == 0.0 or reachable:
00364:         LOGGER.info("RetroAchievements probe failed: %s", reason)

00367: def http_get(url: str, user_agent: str) -> str:
00368:     action = api_action_from_url(url)
00369:     max_retries = 0 if rate_limit.in_background() else HTTP_GET_MAX_429_RETRIES
00370: 
00371:     for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):
00372:         if rate_limit.in_background() and rate_limit.paused_until() is not None:
00373:             raise rate_limit.RateLimitedError(
00374:                 "RetroAchievements asked to slow down; background caching is paused"
00375:             )
00376:         if action is not None:
00377:             _request_throttle.wait(f"GET {action}")
00378: 
00379:         request = urllib.request.Request(
00380:             url,
00381:             headers={
00382:                 "User-Agent": user_agent,
00383:                 "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
00384:             },
00385:             method="GET",
00386:         )
00387:         usage_source = (
00388:             usage_stats.SOURCE_BACKGROUND if rate_limit.in_background() else usage_stats.SOURCE_APP
00389:         )

00391:         try:
00392:             with urllib.request.urlopen(
00393:                 request, timeout=10, context=configured_ssl_context()
00394:             ) as response:
00395:                 if action is not None:
00396:                     usage_stats.record_request(usage_source, getattr(response, "status", 200))
00397:                 body = read_response_bytes(response)
00398:                 mark_retroachievements_reachable()

00400:         except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
00401:             if action is not None:
00402:                 usage_stats.record_request(usage_source, error.code)
00403:             if error.code >= 500:
00404:                 mark_retroachievements_unreachable()

00406:                 mark_retroachievements_reachable()

00408:             if error.code == HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS:
00409:                 rate_limit.on_rate_limited(retry_after_header_millis(error))
00410:                 if attempt < max_retries:
00411:                     retry_after = retry_after_seconds(error, attempt)
00412:                     LOGGER.warning(
00413:                         "GET hit 429 for %s; retrying in %.3fs (attempt %s/%s)",
00414:                         action or redacted_url(url),
00415:                         retry_after,
00416:                         attempt + 1,
00417:                         max_retries,
00418:                     )
00419:                     time.sleep(retry_after)
00420:                     continue
00421: 
00422:             api_error = describe_api_error(error)

00425:                 # str(error) renders, so this is the only way to make the
00426:                 # message callers surface carry RA's actual reason.
00427:                 error.msg = api_error

00431:                 error.reason,
00432:                 user_agent,
00433:                 redacted_url(url),
00434:             )

00436:         except urllib.error.URLError as error:
00437:             if action is not None:
00438:                 usage_stats.record_request(usage_source, None)
00439:             mark_retroachievements_unreachable()
00440:             LOGGER.warning(
00441:                 "GET connection failed reason=%s url=%s",
00442:                 error.reason,
00443:                 redacted_url(url),
00444:             )

00446:         except Exception:

00454: def http_get_bytes(url: str, user_agent: str) -> tuple[bytes, str] | None:
00455:     """Fetches url and returns (body_bytes, content_type), or None on failure."""

00457:         url,
00458:         headers={"User-Agent": user_agent},
00459:         method="GET",
00460:     )

00462:         with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10, context=configured_ssl_context()) as response:
00463:             return response.read(), response_content_type(response) or "application/octet-stream"
00464:     except Exception:
00465:         return None

00468: def describe_api_error(error: urllib.error.HTTPError) -> str | None:
00469:     """Extracts RetroAchievements' own error text from a failed response.
00470: 
00471:     RA answers dorequest.php failures with a JSON body carrying a machine
00472:     readable Code and a human readable Error. Without this the caller only ever
00473:     sees "HTTP Error 403: Forbidden", which hides the actual cause.
00474:     """
00475:     try:
00476:         payload = json.loads(error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
00477:     except Exception:
00478:         return None
00479: 
00480:     if not isinstance(payload, dict):
00481:         return None
00482: 
00483:     code = payload.get("Code")
00484:     message = payload.get("Error")
00485:     if code and message:
00486:         return f"{code}: {message}"
00487:     return code or message or None
00488: 
00489: 
00490: def api_action_from_url(url: str) -> str | None:
00491:     return (
00492:         urlsplit(url).query.split("r=", 1)[1].split("&", 1)[0]
00493:         if "r=" in urlsplit(url).query
00494:         else None
00495:     )
00496: 
00497: 
00498: def retry_after_header_millis(error: urllib.error.HTTPError) -> int | None:
00499:     headers = error.headers
00500:     header_value = ((headers.get("Retry-After") if headers is not None else None) or "").strip()
00501:     return int(header_value) * 1000 if header_value.isdigit() else None
00502: 
00503: 
00504: def retry_after_seconds(error: urllib.error.HTTPError, attempt: int) -> float:
00505:     header_value = (error.headers.get("Retry-After") or "").strip()
00506:     header_seconds = float(header_value) if header_value.isdigit() else None
00507:     if header_seconds is not None and header_seconds > 0:
00508:         return min(header_seconds, HTTP_GET_MAX_429_BACKOFF_SECONDS)
00509: 
00510:     return min(
00511:         HTTP_GET_INITIAL_429_BACKOFF_SECONDS * (2**attempt),
00512:         HTTP_GET_MAX_429_BACKOFF_SECONDS,
00513:     )
00514:

00516: def http_post(
00517:     url: str,
00518:     body: str,
00519:     headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,

00522:     request_headers = {
00523:         "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
00524:         "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
00525:     }
00526:     if headers:
00527:         request_headers.update(headers)

00530:         url,
00531:         data=body.encode("utf-8"),
00532:         headers=request_headers,
00533:         method="POST",

00536:     try:

00551:             usage_stats.record_request(usage_source, error.code)

00557:         LOGGER.warning(

00559:             error.code,

00561:             redacted_url(url),

00584: def online_check(config_data: dict) -> bool:

00588: def build_forward_headers(headers: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
00589:     skip_headers = {
00590:         "host",
00591:         "content-length",
00592:         "connection",
00593:         "transfer-encoding",
00594:         "accept-encoding",
00595:     }
00596:     forwarded: dict[str, str] = {}
00597: 
00598:     for key, value in headers.items():
00599:         lower = key.lower()
00600:         if lower in skip_headers:
00601:             continue
00602:         if lower == "user-agent":
00603:             forwarded[key] = proxy_user_agent(value)
00604:         else:
00605:             forwarded[key] = value
00606: 
00607:     if "User-Agent" not in forwarded and "user-agent" not in forwarded:
00608:         forwarded["User-Agent"] = proxy_user_agent(FALLBACK_USER_AGENT)
00609: 
00610:     return forwarded

00422: def _retroarch_cfg_lookup() -> tuple[tuple[Callable[[], bool], tuple[Path, ...]], ...]:
00423:     """Platform gate paired with that platform's cfg candidates, most specific first.
00424: 
00425:     Built per call so the module globals stay late-bound. Candidates are scoped to
00426:     their own platform on purpose: several firmwares share a card and leave stale
00427:     folders behind, so a single flat "first path that exists wins" list would hand
00428:     back another firmware's config. Each platform's first candidate doubles as its
00429:     fallback, which is what a device that has not generated its cfg yet gets.
00430:     """
00431:     return (
00432:         (lambda: DEFAULT_MUOS_RETROARCH_CFG.exists(), (DEFAULT_MUOS_RETROARCH_CFG,)),
00433:         (lambda: Path("/userdata").exists(), tuple(KNULLI_RETROARCH_CFG_CANDIDATES)),
00434:         (
00435:             lambda: running_on_rocknix() or Path("/storage").exists(),
00436:             (DEFAULT_ROCKNIX_RETROARCH_CFG,),
00437:         ),
00438:         # Ahead of the shared /mnt/SDCARD entry: spruce lives on the same card as Onion
00439:         # but launches RetroArch with --config pointing at a per-device file, so it never
00440:         # reads .retroarch/retroarch.cfg. Candidates stay empty off spruce so the device
00441:         # lookup behind spruce_retroarch_cfg() only runs where it applies.
00442:         (
00443:             running_on_spruce,
00444:             (spruce_retroarch_cfg(),) if running_on_spruce() else (),
00445:         ),
00446:         (lambda: Path("/mnt/SDCARD").exists(), tuple(SDCARD_RETROARCH_CFG_CANDIDATES)),
00447:     )
00448: 
00449: 
00450: def detect_retroarch_cfg() -> str:
00451:     env_override = os.environ.get("RAOFFLINEPROXY_RETROARCH_CFG")
00452:     if env_override:
00453:         return env_override
00454: 
00455:     for platform_matches, candidates in _retroarch_cfg_lookup():
00456:         if not platform_matches() or not candidates:
00457:             continue
00458:         for candidate in candidates:
00459:             if candidate.exists():
00460:                 return str(candidate)
00461:         return str(candidates[0])
00462: 
00463:     return str(Path.home() / ".config" / "retroarch" / "retroarch.cfg")
00464:

00001: from __future__ import annotations
00002: 
00003: """RetroAchievements ROM hashing for the Linux proxy.
00004: 
00005: This is a thin ctypes binding over ``libraproxy_rchash`` — the shared library
00006: built from rcheevos' ``rc_hash`` plus the vendored libchdr-backed CHD reader
00007: (see ``third_party/rcheevos_glue``). All the per-format header-stripping,
00008: sector cooking and disc parsing now lives in that one C library, shared with
00009: the Android build, instead of being re-implemented here in Python.
00010: 
00011: ``raproxy_hash_file(path, out_buffer, max_hashes)`` fills ``out_buffer`` with up
00012: to ``max_hashes`` NUL-terminated 32-char hex hashes (33 bytes each) in rc_hash
00013: iterator order and returns the count. We surface those as ordered candidates;
00014: the caller tries each against the game-id lookup.
00015: 
00016: Note: ``.zip`` archives containing a single console ROM are extracted by the
00017: caller (``rom_browser``) before hashing — rcheevos' own zip path is for
00018: arcade/MAME images, not zipped cartridges. ``.cue`` and ``.m3u`` are resolved
00019: natively by rc_hash from their path.
00020: 
00021: ``.7z`` has no reader in rc_hash at all (it maps the extension to arcade, which
00022: hashes the filename), so the same library exposes
00023: ``raproxy_7z_list_entries``/``raproxy_hash_7z_entry`` on top of the vendored
00024: LZMA SDK. :func:`list_7z_entries` and :func:`hash_7z_entry_candidates` bind
00025: those; ``rom_browser`` applies the same entry-selection rule it uses for zip.
00026: 
00027: ``.rvz`` (Dolphin's compressed GameCube/Wii disc container) is the one format
00028: rc_hash can't read directly — it expects a raw disc layout. Those go through
00029: ``raproxy_hash_disc_datasource`` instead: a random-access callback pair lets
00030: rc_hash pull decompressed disc bytes from :mod:`rvz_datasource`, which does
00031: the container parsing (ported from the Android app's Kotlin RVZ reader).
00032: """
00033:

00035: import ctypes.util
00036: import logging
00037: import os

00039: from pathlib import Path

00046: _MAX_CANDIDATES = 8
00047: _MAX_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES = 512
00048: _ARCHIVE_NAMES_BYTES = 64 * 1024

00051: _LIBRCHASH_ERROR: str | None = None

00054: _DS_SIZE_FN = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_longlong, ctypes.c_void_p)
00055: _DS_READ_FN = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(
00056:     ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_longlong, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int

00058:

00060: @dataclass

00066: def _candidate_library_paths() -> list[str | None]:

00104:         "/userdata/system/raofflineproxy/lib",

00106:         "/run/muos/storage/application/RAOfflineProxy/lib",
00107:         "/storage/.local/share/raofflineproxy/lib",
00108:         "/home/ark/raofflineproxy/lib",
00109:     )
00110:     for base in bases:
00111:         for name in names:
00112:             paths.append(f"{base}/{name}")
00113: 
00114:     return paths
00115: 
00116: 
00117: def load_rchash() -> ctypes.CDLL | None:
00118:     global _LIBRCHASH, _LIBRCHASH_ERROR
00119:     if _LIBRCHASH is not None:
00120:         return _LIBRCHASH
00121:     if _LIBRCHASH_ERROR is not None:
00122:         return None
00123: 
00124:     for candidate in _candidate_library_paths():
00125:         if not candidate:
00126:             continue
00127:         if "/" in candidate and not os.path.isfile(candidate):
00128:             continue
00129:         try:
00130:             library = ctypes.CDLL(candidate)
00131:             library.raproxy_hash_file.argtypes = [
00132:                 ctypes.c_char_p,
00133:                 ctypes.c_char_p,
00134:                 ctypes.c_int,
00135:             ]
00136:             library.raproxy_hash_file.restype = ctypes.c_int
00137:             library.raproxy_hash_disc_datasource.argtypes = [
00138:                 ctypes.c_void_p,
00139:                 _DS_SIZE_FN,
00140:                 _DS_READ_FN,
00141:                 ctypes.c_char_p,
00142:                 ctypes.c_int,
00143:             ]
00144:             library.raproxy_hash_disc_datasource.restype = ctypes.c_int
00145:             _LIBRCHASH = library
00146:             LOGGER.debug("Loaded libraproxy_rchash from %s", candidate)
00147:             return library
00148:         except OSError as exc:
00149:             if _LIBRCHASH_ERROR is None:
00150:                 _LIBRCHASH_ERROR = f"libraproxy_rchash load failed: {exc}"
00151:         except AttributeError as exc:
00152:             if _LIBRCHASH_ERROR is None:
00153:                 _LIBRCHASH_ERROR = f"libraproxy_rchash API mismatch: {exc}"
00154: 
00155:     if _LIBRCHASH_ERROR is None:
00156:         _LIBRCHASH_ERROR = "libraproxy_rchash shared library not found"
00157:     return None
00158: 
00159: 
00160: def _extract_candidates(buffer: ctypes.Array, count: int) -> list[str]:
00161:     candidates: list[str] = []
00162:     for index in range(max(count, 0)):
00163:         chunk = buffer.raw[index * _HASH_STRIDE : (index + 1) * _HASH_STRIDE]
00164:         value = chunk.split(b"\x00", 1)[0].decode("ascii", "ignore").strip().lower()
00165:         if value and value not in candidates:
00166:             candidates.append(value)
00167:     return candidates
00168: 
00169: 
00170: def _generate_disc_datasource_candidates(library: ctypes.CDLL, data_source: RvzDataSource) -> list[str]:
00171:     def size_fn(_ctx: int) -> int:
00172:         return data_source.length
00173: 
00174:     def read_fn(_ctx: int, offset: int, out_buffer: int, num_bytes: int) -> int:
00175:         chunk = data_source.read(offset, num_bytes)
00176:         if not chunk:
00177:             return -1
00178:         ctypes.memmove(out_buffer, chunk, len(chunk))
00179:         return len(chunk)
00180: 
00181:     buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(_MAX_CANDIDATES * _HASH_STRIDE)
00182:     # ctx is required to be non-NULL by raproxy_hash_disc_datasource (used only
00183:     # as a liveness check); the callbacks close over data_source instead.
00184:     count = library.raproxy_hash_disc_datasource(
00185:         ctypes.c_void_p(1), _DS_SIZE_FN(size_fn), _DS_READ_FN(read_fn), buffer, _MAX_CANDIDATES
00186:     )
00187:     return _extract_candidates(buffer, count)
00188: 
00189: 
00190: def _generate_rvz_candidates(path: Path) -> list[str]:
00191:     library = load_rchash()
00192:     if library is None:
00193:         return []
00194: 
00195:     read_source = FileReadSource(str(path))
00196:     try:
00197:         data_source = RvzDataSource.open(read_source)
00198:         if data_source is None:
00199:             LOGGER.warning("Could not open RVZ data source for %s", path)
00200:             return []
00201:         return _generate_disc_datasource_candidates(library, data_source)
00202:     finally:
00203:         read_source.close()
00204: 
00205: 
00206: def _generate_candidates(path: Path) -> list[str]:
00207:     if path.suffix.lower() == ".rvz":
00208:         return _generate_rvz_candidates(path)
00209: 
00210:     library = load_rchash()
00211:     if library is None:
00212:         return []
00213: 
00214:     buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(_MAX_CANDIDATES * _HASH_STRIDE)
00215:     count = library.raproxy_hash_file(
00216:         str(path).encode("utf-8"), buffer, _MAX_CANDIDATES
00217:     )
00218:     return _extract_candidates(buffer, count)
00219: 
00220: 
00221: def hash_rom_candidates_result(path: Path) -> RomHashResult:
00222:     path = Path(path)
00223:     candidates = _generate_candidates(path)
00224:     if candidates:
00225:         return RomHashResult(candidates)
00226: 
00227:     if _LIBRCHASH_ERROR is not None:
00228:         return RomHashResult([], _LIBRCHASH_ERROR)
00229:     return RomHashResult([], f"Could not hash {path.name}")
00230: 
00231: 
00232: def list_7z_entries(path: Path) -> list[str]:
00233:     """Names of the files inside a .7z, or [] if it could not be read."""
00234:     library = load_rchash()
00235:     if library is None:
00236:         return []
00237: 
00238:     buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(_ARCHIVE_NAMES_BYTES)
00239:     count = library.raproxy_7z_list_entries(
00240:         str(path).encode("utf-8"), buffer, _ARCHIVE_NAMES_BYTES, _MAX_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES
00241:     )
00242:     if count <= 0:
00243:         return []
00244: 
00245:     names = buffer.raw.split(b"\x00")[:count]
00246:     return [name.decode("utf-8", "replace") for name in names]
00247: 
00248: 
00249: def hash_7z_entry_candidates(path: Path, entry_name: str) -> list[str]:
00250:     """Hash candidates for one file inside a .7z, hashed by its own content.
00251: 
00252:     Empty when the entry cannot be extracted — an unsupported codec (the reader
00253:     covers LZMA, LZMA2, PPMd and stored entries) or an entry above the native
00254:     size cap. Callers fall back to the arcade hash of the archive name.
00255:     """
00256:     library = load_rchash()
00257:     if library is None:
00258:         return []
00259: 
00260:     buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(_MAX_CANDIDATES * _HASH_STRIDE)
00261:     count = library.raproxy_hash_7z_entry(
00262:         str(path).encode("utf-8"),
00263:         entry_name.encode("utf-8"),
00264:         buffer,
00265:         _MAX_CANDIDATES,
00266:     )
00267:     return _extract_candidates(buffer, count)
00268: 
00269: 
00270: def hash_rom_candidates(path: Path) -> list[str]:
00271:     return hash_rom_candidates_result(path).candidates
00272: 
00273: 
00274: def hash_rom(path: Path) -> str | None:
00275:     candidates = hash_rom_candidates(path)
00276:     return candidates[0] if candidates else None
00277: 
00278: 
00279: def supported_rom_extensions() -> set[str]:
00280:     # Extensions recognized as ROMs for browsing and for picking the file out of
00281:     # an archive. rc_hash hashes most cartridge systems as a plain whole-file
00282:     # MD5, so even extensions it doesn't map by name (e.g. .sms/.gen/.smd) still
00283:     # produce the correct RetroAchievements hash. A single-file archive is also
00284:     # treated as a ROM regardless of extension (see list_archive_rom_entries),
00285:     # so this list does not need to be exhaustive.
00286:     return {
00287:         # Nintendo
00288:         ".nes", ".fds", ".smc", ".sfc", ".fig", ".swc", ".bs",
00289:         ".gb", ".gbc", ".gba", ".nds",
00290:         ".n64", ".z64", ".v64", ".ndd",
00291:         # Sega
00292:         ".md", ".gen", ".smd", ".32x", ".sms", ".gg", ".sg", ".gdi",
00293:         # NEC
00294:         ".pce", ".sgx",
00295:         # Atari
00296:         ".a26", ".a78", ".lnx", ".jag", ".j64",
00297:         # Other cartridge consoles
00298:         ".col", ".int", ".vec", ".vb", ".ws", ".wsc",
00299:         ".ngp", ".ngc", ".min", ".sv", ".chf",
00300:         # Disc / playlist / misc
00301:         ".iso", ".bin", ".chd", ".pbp", ".cue", ".m3u", ".cart", ".rvz", ".wad",
00302:     }

## FILE docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-component-inputs/README.md
Original bytes 3149; SHA256 05c1bf263864f2e1ec2f4417cc615c2f4ca14aa11ae16518876269477fdd2de4
```text
00001: # M7 #528 engineering input disposition — 2026-10-11
00002: 
00003: Eleven missing recipe declarations now name their source-backed primary terms.
00004: HarfBuzz ICU inherits MIT from HarfBuzz; the exact pinned builder resolves it
00005: as MIT/14.3.0. It was a static-collector gap, not a missing runtime declaration.
00006: [The disposition map](dispositions.json) hashes every available retained notice
00007: used here and records the scope and remaining work for all17 prior gaps.
00008: Five aggregate bases remain unresolved: common, GLSL, RetroPie and slang shader
00009: collections, plus ABL. No component, emulator or capability is removed; the
00010: engineering image retains these exact versions with publication held. Root
00011: licence declarations do not clear bundled/vendor inputs or corresponding source.
00012: 
00013: The idtech launcher recipe now fetches the existing Doom archive through the
00014: normal get/checksum/cache path at upstream commit
00015: 4cb65b687c90f56856e9d6a55e51f56a09955699. The download and installed archive match
00016: prior firmware SHA256 ff35cde05801cfb27005229a6c55f20130ffa8f026ca27d7717c03152634e168
00017: (1,689,157 bytes). Installation copies the verified archive without networking.
00018: The archive contains only doom.wad, not a licence notice. The recipe declaration
00019: covers launcher scripts; game-data redistribution terms remain a #528 hold.
00020: 
00021: Final proof69 ended0 in pinned builder
00022: sha256:988c0ba586263caeba4be4c03bd16eee055c9d066657951e320087bb8226ee39,
00023: Python3.10.12: real scripts/unpack from the immutable public URL, checksum and
00024: byte equality, installation with curl/wget refusing calls, actual HarfBuzz ICU
00025: resolution, and corrupt downloader output rejected without an acceptance stamp.
00026: Proof66/67 failed because their wrappers imposed shell options before
00027: config/options unlike the framework's own entrypoints. Both original failures
00028: are retained; proof68 uses its normal startup semantics. Final proof69 repeats the passing
00029: checks after matching the launcher declaration to its actual GPL-2.0 header
00030: (GPL-2.0-only); no broader or-later permission is inferred from the old typo. All12 edited recipes pass pkgcheck.
00031: This is build-input proof; assembled-image inspection and VM QA remain required.
00032: 
00033: The retained WildMIDI cache enables WANT_PLAYER. Its metadata therefore records
00034: both LGPL library and GPL player terms; this pass does not change that build
00035: option. ABL v1.1.9 still names LinuxLoader4588733123554b1f7bf935b04e494e4284894546;
00036: public packaging/release metadata is not implementation-source clearance.
00037: Shader per-file terms, vendor coverage, prebuilt provenance (including rclone's
00038: modified=true), final-image inventory, independent retrieval and off-host source
00039: custody remain publication work. No RC is allocated or publication approved.
00040: 
00041: Can this be done on the VM? Yes for installed artifacts and behavior. Build
00042: fetch/resolution checks use the exact builder first; no owner cloud or device
00043: operation occurred. The scoped review checked unchanged payload equality,
00044: late-bound recipe paths, normal checksum failure behavior, effective inherited
00045: metadata and source-backed declarations. It does not reopen the completed
00046: #540 audit or extend that audit's scope to these changes.
```

00001: # M7.P5 dependency refresh — #541
00002: 
00003: Freshness71 stopped the initial combined-image freeze before compilation:
00004: rclone1.75.1 was behind1.75.2 and RAOfflineProxy879b158 was14 commits behind.
00005: The initial63a2090a56 cache-copy freeze is superseded for compilation; its
00006: independent cache can be reused after verification and an explicit new freeze.
00007: 
00008: ## Source and compatibility
00009: 
00010: rclone1.75.2 amd64 and arm64 archives match upstream SHA256SUMS and independent
00011: hashing (`fetch.json`). The [upstream release notes](https://rclone.org/changelog/#v1-75-2-2026-10-09)
00012: include security repairs, network retry/cancellation fixes, and Dropbox shared
00013: folder handling changes. Hosted-provider success is not inferred from those notes.
00014: Full WebDAV/SFTP/local S3 backup/restore regression remains an installed-image gate.
00015: 
00016: RAOfflineProxyc7ebd1b6e777f3751ff0ecdf8aba54045844e00d changes Linux background
00017: queue pacing and adds opt-in watched folders. No automatic watched folder is
00018: configured by this fork. The16-patch series applies without fuzz;001/004/005/011/012
00019: were context-rebased. Coupled rcheevos1433173220a7eaede6a9ed7a18e94117be1821e0
00020: and libchdr607694ca0812edfc9cc2030c64634fc2393668de remain unchanged.
00021: Storage review found a protected watch-seen key prefix, with no changed SQL
00022: cache/award columns. This source review is backed by an actual predecessor-written
00023: store reopened by the new code, not just a revised schema annotation.
00024: 
00025: The removed upstream cooldown helper made our preparation command fail at
00026: import (`old-helper-failure.json`). A local compatibility helper preserves its
00027: existing30-second pause after each50 games. The deliberate OS whole-library
00028: command still opts out of the100-game background window; it retains request
00029: throttling, persistent server pauses, and truthful queued-versus-ready outcomes.
00030: Upstream's background queue keeps its new pacing. This is a preservation change,
00031: not an attempt to disable the new upstream background safety behavior.
00032: 
00033: ## Completed source proof
00034: 
00035: `proxy74`: actual recipe-built native library,866 upstream Linux tests with no
00036: skips and11 fork integration tests pass. Real old879b158 source writes the store;
00037: cache/sign-in/base/subset pending-award rows and old image paths survive reopens.
00038: Synthetic game/HTTP boundaries exercise125-game preparation, failure/retry,
00039: persisted429 refusal and default100-game queue behavior. No account-backed award
00040: or owner cloud/device mutation occurs. Source seals and original terminal receipts
00041: are retained. Installed service, native formats, consent transitions and reconnect
00042: proof remain required on the new image.
00043: 
00044: `discovery-fixture.json`: an actual temporary Git repository reproduces stale
00045: archived docs/package.mk fixtures being discovered as active recipes. Restricting
00046: the search to build-engine roots packages/ and projects/ excludes them while
00047: retaining active root and override recipes and the explicitly owned rclone recipe.
00048: The fixture changes discovery only; it does not exempt either real update.
00049: 
00050: Can this be done on the VM? Yes: installed protocol, service and retained-state
00051: proof follows assembly. Source/native harness checks run locally first. No physical
00052: handheld fact is involved. ES stays atc8dc72cf9e; no screen or navigation is changed
00053: by this refresh. Its existing flow reference remains current, with exact new-image
00054: frames to be recorded during combined qualification.

00056: ## Original integration-harness failures retained
00057: 
00058: Regression75's focused11 integration checks pass, but its broad suite ends with
00059: 2 failures and26 skipped checks. The new proxy archive was not in the cache the
00060: suite searches, so proxy sections did not run. Two final host helpers lost the
00061: owned TMPDIR when the harness deliberately cleared it for bubblewrap and hit the
00062: host /tmp user quota. No skipped check is counted as passed. Fresh79 supplies the
00063: verified archive and new rclone binary, and scopes TMPDIR to those host helpers.
00064: 
00065: The first cache comparison failed on seven generated predecessor .pyc files plus
00066: their directory metadata. Actual predecessor imports created these during copying.
00067: The integration tool now suppresses predecessor bytecode writes. The original
00068: nine-line comparison and nonzero terminal result remain; a fresh owner performs
00069: another full checksum comparison and inode independence verification.
00070: 
00071: ## Cache accepted; patch-test quota isolated
00072: 
00073: `cache-recheck` ended0: empty full checksum comparison and2,532,289 independent
00074: regular-file inode pairs. Original copying did not produce firmware. New build

00077: `patch-temp80` reproduces the two RetroArch dry-run failures with the default

00079: patches apply in package order and every required zero-fuzz dry run passes with
00080: the owned temporary directory. Product patches did not change. This separates a
00081: host fixture failure from a product patch failure; the original full run remains
00082: failed until its exact corrected section is separately verified.
00083: 
00084: ## Final source disposition
00085: 
00086: Fresh79: upstream freshness0, both recipe lints0, proxy schema guard0 and11 fork

## FILE docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-installed-proxy/guest-proof.py

```text
00001: """Run only packaged proxy modules, with predecessor-written synthetic state."""
00002: import os,json,sys,time,hashlib,subprocess,urllib.request,urllib.error
00003: from pathlib import Path
00004: root=Path('/storage/.config/raofflineproxy');os.environ['RAOFFLINEPROXY_CONFIG_DIR']=str(root)
00005: from raofflineproxy import config,storage,cache_keys,rom_cache,image_cache,auth
00006: checks=[]
00007: def check(ok,name):
00008:  checks.append({'assertion':name,'passed':bool(ok)});print(('PASS ' if ok else 'FAIL ')+name,flush=True)
00009:  (root/'assertions.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks,indent=2)+'\n');assert ok,name
00010: check(config.__file__.startswith('/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/'),'actual packaged modules, no source override')
00011: check(config.running_on_rocknix(),'packaged detector recognizes pixelelated')
00012: check(config.detect_rocknix_system_cfg({})=='/storage/.config/system/configs/system.cfg','canonical account path is discovered without override')
00013: before=json.loads((root/'before.json').read_text())
00014: for i in range(2):
00015:  st=storage.Storage()
00016:  check(sorted(st.iter_cache_by_prefix(''),key=lambda r:r['cacheKey'])==sorted(before['cache'],key=lambda r:r['cacheKey']),f'reopen {i+1} retains all predecessor cache rows')
00017:  check(st.get_pending_awards()==before['awards'],f'reopen {i+1} retains all predecessor pending rows')
00018:  check(rom_cache.find_achievement_game_ids(st,{1,2})=={1:100,2:200},f'reopen {i+1} retains base/subset award mapping')
00019:  check(st.load_login_credentials()=={'user':'QA','token':'<synthetic>'},f'reopen {i+1} retains synthetic cached sign-in')
00020:  check({row['cacheKey'] for row in st.cached_game_meta(100)}=={'patch:100:qa','achievementsets:abc:qa'},f'reopen {i+1} backfills inherited game metadata')
00021:  st.close()
00022: check(image_cache.resolve_cached_static_asset('/Badge/old.png').read_bytes()==(root/'image_cache/static/Badge/old.png').read_bytes(),'legacy unsharded image path remains readable')
00023: st=storage.Storage();cred=auth.resolve_credentials(st,{});st.close()
00024: check(bool(cred and cred.get('user')=='QA' and cred.get('token')=='<synthetic>'),'packaged resolver reads canonical synthetic account automatically')
00025: (root/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'proxy_host':'127.0.0.1','proxy_port':18080,'upstream_host':'http://127.0.0.1:9','cache_images':True,'upload_logs':False,'upload_usage_stats':False}))
00026: # No default route exists in this disposable guest; upstream is also loopback.
00027: log=(root/'service-private.log').open('wb')
00028: p=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/python3','-m','raofflineproxy.main','run-service'],env=dict(os.environ),stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
00029: (root/'owned-service.pid').write_text(str(p.pid)+'\n')
00030: def get(path,as_json=True):
00031:  req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18080'+path,headers={'X-RA-Store-Only':'1'})
00032:  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5) as response:
00033:   data=response.read();return json.loads(data) if as_json else data
00034: try:
00035:  for i in range(60):
00036:   if p.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('packaged service exited before readiness')
00037:   try:patch=get('/dorequest.php?r=patch&g=100&u=QA');break
00038:   except (OSError,ValueError):time.sleep(.5)
00039:  else:raise RuntimeError('packaged service did not become ready')
00040:  check(patch.get('PatchData',{}).get('Title')=='old cached game','real packaged service serves inherited game cache')
00041:  sets=get('/dorequest.php?r=achievementsets&m=abc&u=QA')
00042:  check([x['GameId'] for x in sets['Sets']]==[100,200],'real service serves inherited base and subset sets')
00043:  for game,achievement in [(100,1),(200,2)]:
00044:   response=get(f'/dorequest.php?r=unlocks&g={game}&u=QA')
00045:   check(achievement in response.get('UserUnlocks',[]),f'queued award remains visible in game {game}')
00046:  check(get('/Badge/old.png',False)==(root/'image_cache/static/Badge/old.png').read_bytes(),'real service serves original legacy image bytes')
00047:  st=storage.Storage();awards=st.get_pending_awards();st.close()
00048:  check(len(awards)==2 and {x['achievementId'] for x in awards}=={1,2},'offline service retains both queued awards without flushing')
00049: finally:
00050:  p.terminate()
00051:  try:p.wait(timeout=15)
00052:  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait();raise
00053:  log.close()
00054: check(p.poll() is not None,'owned packaged service stops cleanly')
00055: print('PASS packaged account discovery, predecessor cache/sign-in/queue reopen and offline HTTP service',flush=True)
```

## FILE docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-installed-proxy/consent-test.py
Original bytes 11490; SHA256 e369293a9f0156a39213a7c519458463977288bbcbaa1cdde2851c5410d75013
```text
00001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
00002: # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
00003: # Copyright (C) 2026-present pixelelated
00004: """Prove installed reporting consent in an isolated QA guest with no default route.
00005: 
00006: Uses real packaged reporting functions, SQLite and loopback HTTP. Only the log
00007: upload destination constant is redirected; no reporting/consent function is
00008: replaced. Does not prove scheduler timing, UI consent or a real provider.
00009: """
00010: import argparse
00011: import hashlib
00012: import http.server
00013: import importlib
00014: import io
00015: import json
00016: import os
00017: from pathlib import Path
00018: import subprocess
00019: import sys
00020: import threading
00021: import time
00022: import zipfile
00023: 
00024: 
00025: def save(path, value):
00026:     path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
00027: 
00028: 
00029: def child(root, name, endpoint, replay, require_early_uptime):
00030:     state = root / name
00031:     state.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=replay)
00032:     os.environ['RAOFFLINEPROXY_CONFIG_DIR'] = str(state)
00033:     os.environ['RAOFFLINEPROXY_USAGE_URL'] = endpoint + '/usage'
00034:     modules = {n: importlib.import_module('raofflineproxy.' + n) for n in
00035:                ['config', 'cache_keys', 'storage', 'usage_stats', 'usage_report',
00036:                 'storage_corruption', 'log_uploader', 'proxy_service']}
00037:     loaded = {}
00038:     for name_, module in modules.items():
00039:         path = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
00040:         if not path.is_relative_to('/usr/lib') or path.suffix != '.pyc':
00041:             raise RuntimeError('Refusing non-installed bytecode: ' + str(path))
00042:         loaded[str(path)] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
00043:     cfg, stats = modules['config'], modules['usage_stats']
00044:     report, corruption = modules['usage_report'], modules['storage_corruption']
00045:     uploader, service = modules['log_uploader'], modules['proxy_service']
00046:     assert cfg.CONFIG_DIR.resolve() == state.resolve()
00047:     uploader.REQUEST_UPLOAD_URL = endpoint + '/request-upload'
00048:     # Deliberately synthetic cached sign-in: enough to make reporting eligible.
00049:     synthetic_name, synthetic_session = 'QAConsentOnly', 'qa-' + 'only'
00050:     store = modules['storage'].Storage()
00051:     try:
00052:         if not replay:
00053:             store.upsert_cache(modules['cache_keys'].login(synthetic_name),
00054:                                json.dumps({'User': synthetic_name, 'Token': synthetic_session}))
00055:             assert store.load_login_credentials() is not None
00056:             value, version, logs, expected_usage, expected_logs = CASES[name]
00057:             data = {'usage_stats_consent_version': version}
00058:             if name != 'unanswered':
00059:                 data['usage_stats_consent'] = value
00060:                 data['upload_logs'] = logs
00061:             cfg.save_config(data)
00062:             stats.USAGE_STATS_FILE.write_text(json.dumps({'requests_emulator': 7}))
00063:             if name == 'explicit-decline':
00064:                 stats.save_consent(False)
00065:                 assert not stats.USAGE_STATS_FILE.exists(), 'decline did not clear counters'
00066:                 # Old on-disk counters must not bypass the consent guard either.
00067:                 stats.USAGE_STATS_FILE.write_text(json.dumps({'requests_emulator': 7}))
00068:             uptime = time.monotonic()
00069:             stats.record_request(stats.SOURCE_EMULATOR, 200)
00070:             stats.flush()
00071:             actual = stats.snapshot().get('requests_emulator')
00072:             expected = 8 if expected_usage else 7
00073:             save(root / (name + '-counter-observation.json'),
00074:                  {'uptime_seconds': uptime, 'actual': actual, 'expected': expected,
00075:                   'installed_modules': loaded})

00106: 
00107: # usage consent, consent version, independent log consent, expected usage/log sends
00108: CASES = {
00109:     # Exercise the granted path first so a fast boot can prove #457 directly.
00110:     'usage-only': (True, 1, False, True, False),
00111:     'unanswered': (None, 1, None, False, False),
00112:     'declined': (False, 1, False, False, False),

00128: def main():
00129:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
00130:     parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)

00135:     parser.add_argument('--require-early-uptime', action='store_true',
00136:                         help='require the first granted counter before the 30-second cache interval')
00137:     args = parser.parse_args()
00138:     if args.case:
00139:         if not args.endpoint or not args.endpoint.startswith('http://127.0.0.1:'):
00140:             parser.error('child requires loopback endpoint')
00141:         child(args.output, args.case, args.endpoint, args.replay, args.require_early_uptime)
00142:         return 0
00143:     identity = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in Path('/etc/os-release').read_text().splitlines()
00144:                     if '=' in line)
00145:     if not args.expected_build or identity.get('BUILD_ID', '').strip('"') != args.expected_build:
00146:         parser.error('exact expected BUILD_ID required')
00147:     for family in ['-4', '-6']:
00148:         routes = subprocess.check_output(['ip', family, 'route', 'show', 'default'], text=True)
00149:         if routes.strip():
00150:             parser.error('remove guest default routes before isolated proof')
00151:     root = args.output.resolve()
00152:     if not root.is_relative_to('/storage/.cache'):
00153:         parser.error('output must be a fresh directory under /storage/.cache')
00154:     root.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
00155:     events = []
00156: 
00157:     class Collector(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
00158:         def log_message(self, *unused):
00159:             pass
00160: 
00161:         def do_POST(self):
00162:             self.receive()
00163: 
00164:         def do_PUT(self):
00165:             self.receive()
00166: 
00167:         def receive(self):
00168:             body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0')))
00169:             event = {'method': self.command, 'path': self.path, 'bytes': len(body),
00170:                      'sha256': hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}
00171:             response, code = b'{}', 200
00172:             if self.path == '/usage' and self.command == 'POST':
00173:                 payload = json.loads(body)
00174:                 assert payload['counters']['requests_emulator'] == 8
00175:                 assert b'QAConsentOnly' not in body and b'qa-only' not in body
00176:                 event['payload_fields'] = sorted(payload)
00177:             elif self.path == '/request-upload' and self.command == 'POST':
00178:                 response = json.dumps({'id': 'qa-upload', 'uploadUrl': endpoint + '/upload'}).encode()
00179:             elif self.path == '/upload' and self.command == 'PUT':
00180:                 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(body)) as archive:
00181:                     event['archive_members'] = sorted(archive.namelist())
00182:                     assert 'storage_corruption.txt' in archive.namelist()
00183:                     assert b'synthetic QA incident' in archive.read('storage_corruption.txt')
00184:             else:
00185:                 code = 404
00186:             events.append(event)
00187:             self.send_response(code)
00188:             self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(response)))
00189:             self.end_headers()
00190:             self.wfile.write(response)
00191: 
00192:     server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Collector)
00193:     endpoint = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + str(server.server_port)
00194:     thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
00195:     thread.start()
00196:     results = []
00197:     try:
00198:         for name, (_, _, _, usage, logs) in CASES.items():
00199:             for replay in [False, True]:
00200:                 before = len(events)
00201:                 command = [sys.executable, '-I', str(Path(__file__).resolve()), '--output',
00202:                            str(root), '--case', name, '--endpoint', endpoint]
00203:                 if replay:

00205:                 if args.require_early_uptime:
00206:                     command.append('--require-early-uptime')
00207:                 run = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=45)
00208:                 (root / (name + ('-replay' if replay else '') + '.log')).write_text(run.stdout + run.stderr)
00209:                 assert run.returncode == 0, (name, replay, run.returncode)
00210:                 observed = [(e['method'], e['path']) for e in events[before:]]
00211:                 expected = [] if replay else ([('POST', '/usage')] if usage else []) + (
00212:                     [('POST', '/request-upload'), ('PUT', '/upload')] if logs else [])
00213:                 assert observed == expected, (name, replay, observed, expected)
00214:                 results.append({'case': name, 'replay': replay, 'requests': len(observed)})
00215:                 save(root / 'collector-events.json', events)
00216:                 print('PASS', name, 'restart' if replay else 'first call', len(observed), 'HTTP requests', flush=True)
00217:         save(root / 'summary.json', {'build_id': args.expected_build, 'checks': len(results),
00218:                                     'results': results, 'external_provider_contact': False,
00219:                                     'required_early_uptime': args.require_early_uptime,
00220:                                     'scope': 'Installed reporting functions and actual loopback HTTP; no scheduler/UI proof'})
00221:     finally:
00222:         save(root / 'collector-events.json', events)
00223:         server.shutdown()
00224:         server.server_close()

00006: built library via the ``RAOFFLINEPROXY_RCHASH_LIB`` env var (the CI/build step

00212:     LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Discovery must not depend on a single hardcoded install
00213:     path (regression: Onion PS1 hashing failed when installed off the canonical
00214:     /mnt/SDCARD/App/RAOfflineProxy path)."""
00215: 
00216:     def test_searches_bundle_lib_two_levels_up(self) -> None:
00217:         here = Path(rom_hashing.__file__).resolve().parent
00218:         bundle_lib = str(here.parent.parent / "lib" / "libraproxy_rchash.so")
00219:         self.assertIn(bundle_lib, rom_hashing._candidate_library_paths())
00220: 
00221:     def test_includes_bare_sonames_for_ld_library_path(self) -> None:
00222:         candidates = rom_hashing._candidate_library_paths()
00223:         self.assertIn("libraproxy_rchash.so", candidates)
00224:         self.assertIn("libraproxy_rchash.dylib", candidates)
00225: 
00226: 
00227: if __name__ == "__main__":
00228:     unittest.main()
```

```text
00001: # Container temporary-path scope — #549
00002: 
00003: Initial build20 stopped before compilation with original inner/outer/launcher2:
00004: the host-only TMPDIR was forwarded into an unmounted container path. Pinned
00005: nonroot controls reproduce failure there and success at container-local /tmp.
00006: Build20b explicitly scopes Docker TMPDIR to /tmp. Its actual container completed
00007: with exit0, all643 tasks and image assembly; the original wrapper remains1.
00008: Its monitor incorrectly required Docker inspect to contain only one TMPDIR
00009: entry. Docker retains both configured entries; actual runtime readback and
00010: mktemp prove /tmp is effective. Container ID matches the build cidfile.
00011: 
00012: Independent watched build20-verify ended0 at19:50:49UTC. It verifies actual
00013: container image/user/mount/runtime evidence, three refusal controls, frozen
00014: source and every assembled mapping/identity. No product change, recompilation,
00015: input substitution or original result overwrite. This composed acceptance is
00016: explicit about the failed observer; it does not relabel either original owner.
00017: Raw/update payload, installed-tree delta and clean/upgrade VM qualification
00018: remain separate #548 requirements. No owner device/cloud was touched.
```

00001: """Exercise the shipped C++ callbacks with real deletion and AddressSanitizer.
00002: 
00003: Only rendering/network work is replaced by small doubles. The choice-page
00004: function and cloudSetupPresent are extracted unchanged from the source under
00005: test; this is a lifetime regression check, not a full device UI test.
00006: """
00007: from pathlib import Path
00008: import os
00009: import subprocess
00010: import sys
00011: import tempfile
00012: 
00013: source_path = (Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else
00014:                Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "es-app/src/guis/GuiMenu.cpp")
00015: source = source_path.read_text()
00016: 
00017: def definition(name):
00018:     start = source.index('static void ' + name + '(')
00019:     while source.index(';', start) < source.index('{', start):
00020:         start = source.index('static void ' + name + '(', start + 1)
00021:     brace = source.index('{', start)
00022:     depth = 1
00023:     end = brace + 1
00024:     while depth:
00025:         if source[end] == '{':
00026:             depth += 1
00027:         elif source[end] == '}':
00028:             depth -= 1
00029:         end += 1
00030:     return source[start:end]
00031: 
00032: harness = r'''
00033: #include <algorithm>
00034: #include <cassert>
00035: #include <functional>
00036: #include <iostream>
00037: #include <string>
00038: #include <utility>
00039: #include <vector>
00040: #include <set>
00041: #include <sstream>

00107: harness += '\n' + definition('cloudSetupPresent') + '\n'

00109: static void cloudOAuthShowSignIn(Window* window, const CloudBackend&,
00110:     const std::string&, GuiSettings* prev, bool phone, const CloudOAuthReady&)
00111: {
00112:     lastPhone = phone;
00113:     auto page = new GuiSettings(window, "Sign in");
00114:     cloudOAuthOwnSession(page);   // as the shipped sign-in page does
00115:     cloudSetupPresent(window, page, prev);
00116: }
00117: '''
00118: harness += '\n' + definition('cloudOAuthPresentChoice') + '\n'
00119: harness += r'''
00120: int main(int argc, char** argv) {
00121:     assert(argc == 2);
00122:     const std::string route = argv[1];
00123:     Window window;
00124:     auto hub = new GuiSettings(&window, "Cloud hub");
00125:     window.pushGui(hub);
00126:     auto providers = new GuiSettings(&window, "Providers");
00127:     window.pushGui(providers);
00128:     CloudBackend backend;
00129:     CloudOAuthReady ready;
00130:     if (route == "no-browser") ready.onDevice = false;
00131:     if (route == "failed-start") ready.started = false;
00132:     cloudOAuthPresentChoice(&window, backend, "dropbox", providers, ready);
00133:     assert(window.stack.size() == 2);
00134:     assert(window.stack.front() == hub);
00135:     if (route == "phone" || route == "keyboard") {
00136:         auto chooser = window.stack.back();
00137:         const std::string label = route == "phone"
00138:             ? "WITH MY PHONE" : "WITH THE ON-SCREEN KEYBOARD";
00139:         auto row = std::find_if(chooser->choices.begin(), chooser->choices.end(),
00140:             [&label](const auto& entry) { return entry.first == label; });
00141:         assert(row != chooser->choices.end());
00142:         // ES event dispatch can outlive the page being replaced. Keep the
00143:         // invocation alive while testing what page its callback hands over.
00144:         const auto action = row->second;
00145:         action();
00146:         assert(window.stack.size() == 2);
00147:         assert(window.stack.front() == hub);
00148:         assert(window.stack.back() != chooser);
00149:         assert(lastPhone == (route == "phone"));
00150:     } else {
00151:         assert(lastPhone);
00152:     }
00153:     // Handing the session from page to page cancels nothing.
00154:     if (gCancels != 0) { std::cout << "FAIL " << route << ": a page handed on cancelled the sign-in's session\n"; return 1; }
00155:     // Back from sign-in must return directly to the hub -- and leaving the
00156:     // sign-in is the player leaving it: its session is cancelled, once.
00157:     window.stack.back()->close();
00158:     assert(window.stack.size() == 1 && window.stack.back() == hub);
00159:     if (gCancels != 1) { std::cout << "FAIL " << route << ": the sign-in was left and its session was cancelled " << gCancels << " times\n"; return 1; }
00160:     hub->close();
00161:     assert(window.stack.empty());
00162:     std::cout << "PASS " << route << '\n';
00163: }
